examples.en: Our new controller changed the accounting policy on inventory from FIFO to weighted average.
examples.zh: 我们的新任主计长把存货的「会计政策」从先进先出法改成了加权平均法。

examples.en: Any change in accounting policy must be disclosed in the notes together with the reasons.
examples.zh: 「会计政策」如有变更，必须在附注中连同原因一并披露。

words.enDefinition: amounts a business owes to suppliers for goods or services received

examples.en: The supplier called because our accounts payable had sat unpaid for almost two months.
examples.zh: 供应商打电话来催款，因为我们的「应付账款」已经拖了将近两个月没付。

examples.en: At month end I reconciled the accounts payable ledger against the supplier statements.
examples.zh: 月末时，我把「应付账款」明细账与供应商对账单逐笔核对了一遍。

words.enDefinition: amounts owed to a business by customers for goods or services delivered

examples.en: Our accounts receivable keep climbing because two big customers now pay sixty days late.
examples.zh: 我们的「应收账款」不断攀升，因为两家大客户现在要拖六十天才付款。

examples.en: The credit team ages every account in accounts receivable before chasing overdue balances.
examples.zh: 信用小组在催收逾期款项之前，会先按账龄对「应收账款」逐户分类。

words.enDefinition: the recognition of income or expenses in the period earned or incurred rather than when cash is settled

examples.en: Under accrual accounting, we record December's rent expense even though the landlord is paid in January.
examples.zh: 按「应计确认」的要求，即使一月份才付给房东租金，我们也要在十二月确认租金费用。

examples.en: My tutor explained that accrual matches income and expenses to the period they actually relate to.
examples.zh: 老师解释说，「应计确认」就是把收入和费用归入它们实际所属的期间。

words.enDefinition: an expense recognized before the related cash payment is made

examples.en: We booked the December electricity as an accrued expense because the bill had not arrived.
examples.zh: 电费账单还没寄到，我们先把十二月的电费记作一项「应计费用」。

examples.en: Remember to reverse the accrued expense once the supplier's invoice is finally received.
examples.zh: 供应商的发票最终收到后，记得把那笔「应计费用」冲回。

words.enDefinition: income recognized before the related cash receipt occurs

examples.en: Three days of interest had built up, so we recorded it as accrued income.
examples.zh: 已经累积了三天的利息，我们把它确认为「应计收入」。

examples.en: Consulting work finished in March stays accrued income until the client actually pays in April.
examples.zh: 三月完成的咨询工作仍列为「应计收入」，直到客户四月真正付款。

words.enDefinition: total depreciation recognized on an asset since acquisition

examples.en: The van's accumulated depreciation has almost caught up with its purchase price after eight years.
examples.zh: 八年下来，这辆货车的「累计折旧」已经快赶上它的购入价了。

examples.en: On the balance sheet, equipment appears net of accumulated depreciation, not at original cost.
examples.zh: 在资产负债表上，设备按扣除「累计折旧」后的净额列示，而不是按原始成本。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “accumulated depreciation” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied an accumulated depreciation to a short case study.

words.enDefinition: an entry made at period end to update accounts before financial statements are prepared

examples.en: Before closing the month, I posted an adjusting entry for the unused office supplies.
examples.zh: 结账前，我针对剩余的办公用品编制了一张「调整分录」。

examples.en: The senior showed me how an adjusting entry moves prepaid rent into this month's expense.
examples.zh: 前辈教我如何用「调整分录」把预付租金转入本月费用。

words.enDefinition: variance that reduces profit relative to the standard or budget

examples.en: The wage bill ran over budget, leaving an adverse variance we had to explain to finance.
examples.zh: 工资支出超出预算，形成了一笔必须向财务部门解释的「不利差异」。

examples.en: Every adverse variance gets investigated, but small ones under fifty pounds are simply noted.
examples.zh: 每一笔「不利差异」都要调查，不过五十英镑以下的小额差异只需记录备案。

words.enDefinition: an estimate of receivables expected to become uncollectible

examples.en: We raised the allowance for doubtful accounts after the retailer's credit rating was downgraded.
examples.zh: 那家零售商的信用评级被下调后，我们提高了「坏账准备」。

examples.en: The auditor tested our allowance for doubtful accounts by checking how old each invoice was.
examples.zh: 审计师通过核对每张发票的账龄，测试了我们「坏账准备」的计提是否合理。

words.enDefinition: systematic allocation of the cost of an intangible asset over its useful life

examples.en: The software licence costs sixty thousand, so amortisation spreads it over five years.
examples.zh: 这套软件许可花费六万英镑，通过「摊销」分摊到五年里。

examples.en: I forgot this quarter's amortisation, so profit looked better than it should have.
examples.zh: 我漏记了本季度的「摊销」，结果利润比实际水平虚高了一截。

words.enDefinition: an audit procedure that evaluates relationships among financial and non-financial data

examples.en: A simple analytical procedure comparing sales to last year flagged the missing revenue.
examples.zh: 一项把销售额与去年对比的「分析程序」，发现了那笔缺失的收入。

examples.en: The senior asked me to run an analytical procedure over payroll costs before fieldwork started.
examples.zh: 现场工作开始前，高级审计员让我对工资费用执行一项「分析程序」。

words.enDefinition: resource controlled by an entity that is expected to provide future economic benefits

examples.en: The delivery van is an asset because it will bring the firm benefits for years.
examples.zh: 那辆送货货车是一项「资产」，因为它未来多年都能给公司带来收益。

examples.en: Lenders look at every asset we own before deciding how much credit to extend.
examples.zh: 贷款机构在决定放多少额度之前，会逐项审视我们持有的「资产」。

words.enDefinition: ratio measuring revenue generated relative to the asset base

examples.en: Their asset turnover improved once the idle warehouse was finally sold off.
examples.zh: 闲置仓库出售之后，他们的「资产周转率」明显改善了。

examples.en: A high asset turnover with thin margins can still produce a decent overall return.
examples.zh: 「资产周转率」高但利润率薄的企业，整体回报仍然可能不错。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “asset turnover” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the asset turnover affects the accounts.

words.enDefinition: an independent examination of financial information and related evidence

examples.en: Our year-end audit starts next Monday, so the whole team is tidying up files.
examples.zh: 年度「审计」下周一进场，整个团队都在整理凭证档案。

examples.en: The charity commission requires an audit once income passes the statutory threshold.
examples.zh: 一旦收入超过法定门槛，慈善委员会就要求进行「审计」。

words.enDefinition: information used by an auditor to support conclusions and opinions

examples.en: Bank confirmations are among the most reliable audit evidence you can obtain.
examples.zh: 银行询证回函是最可靠的「审计证据」之一。

examples.en: Without enough audit evidence, the senior simply could not sign off the payroll balance.
examples.zh: 由于缺少充分的「审计证据」，高级审计员无法对工资余额予以认可。

words.enDefinition: the auditor's formal conclusion on whether financial statements are fairly presented

examples.en: The client was relieved when the audit opinion came back completely unqualified.
examples.zh: 「审计意见」出具为完全无保留，客户悬着的心总算放下了。

examples.en: A qualified audit opinion on the inventory count made the bank reconsider the loan.
examples.zh: 针对存货盘点出具的保留「审计意见」，让银行重新考虑了那笔贷款。

words.enDefinition: specific action performed to obtain audit evidence

examples.en: Observing the stocktake is a standard audit procedure we never skip at year end.
examples.zh: 监盘存货是我们年末从不省略的一项标准「审计程序」。

examples.en: Each audit procedure in the programme names who performs it and which assertion it covers.
examples.zh: 审计方案中的每一项「审计程序」都注明了执行人及其覆盖的认定。

words.enDefinition: formal report containing the auditor's opinion and related information

examples.en: Shareholders receive the audit report alongside the annual accounts each spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，股东都会随年度账目一起收到「审计报告」。

examples.en: The partner spent a whole afternoon rewording the audit report before it went out.
examples.zh: 发出之前，合伙人花了整整一个下午斟酌「审计报告」的措辞。

words.enDefinition: sequence of records that allows a transaction to be traced from source to financial statements

examples.en: Every invoice links to its purchase order, giving the system a clean audit trail.
examples.zh: 每张发票都关联对应的采购订单，让系统留下完整的「审计轨迹」。

examples.en: Once a payment is deleted, the audit trail still shows who approved it and when.
examples.zh: 即使付款记录被删除，「审计轨迹」仍会显示当初是谁在何时批准的。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: In class we applied an _____ to a short case study.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied an audit trail to a short case study.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “audit trail” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied an audit trail to a short case study.

words.enDefinition: professional who examines financial statements, records, and controls

examples.en: Our auditor asked for the November bank statements and the signed loan agreement.
examples.zh: 「审计师」索要了十一月的银行对账单和已签署的贷款协议。

examples.en: As an auditor you must stay independent, so I cannot hold shares in this client.
examples.zh: 作为「审计师」必须保持独立，所以我不可以持有这家客户的股票。

words.enDefinition: a receivable that has been judged irrecoverable and is written off (distinct from a doubtful debt that is still possibly collectible)

examples.en: The bakery's collapse left us a bad debt of nearly nine thousand pounds.
examples.zh: 那家面包店倒闭，给我们留下近九千英镑的「坏账」。

examples.en: After two years of chasing, we finally wrote the invoice off as a bad debt.
examples.zh: 追讨两年无果后，我们最终把那张发票作为「坏账」核销了。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “bad debt” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The company wrote off the bad debt after all collection attempts failed.

words.enDefinition: comparison of accounting cash records with the bank statement to explain differences

examples.en: The bank reconciliation found two unpresented cheques and one deposit still in transit.
examples.zh: 「银行存款余额调节」发现两张未兑现支票和一笔在途存款。

examples.en: My first task each Monday is the bank reconciliation for the shop's current account.
examples.zh: 每周一我的第一件事，就是给店铺的往来账户做「银行存款余额调节」。

usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the bank reconciliation without reading the notes.

words.enDefinition: the level of activity at which total revenue equals total cost

examples.en: Selling four hundred mugs a month puts the studio just past its break-even point.
examples.zh: 每月卖出四百个马克杯，工作室刚好越过「盈亏平衡点」。

examples.en: Rent rose sharply, so the cafe's break-even point moved from ninety to one hundred ten covers.
examples.zh: 房租大涨后，咖啡馆的「盈亏平衡点」从九十客升到了一百一十客。

words.enDefinition: quantified plan for revenue, costs, cash, or other activities over a future period

examples.en: Marketing blew through its budget by March, mostly on one expensive trade show.
examples.zh: 市场部到三月份就把「预算」花超了，大头是那次昂贵的展会。

examples.en: Before approving the budget, the board questioned every line that had grown over ten percent.
examples.zh: 批准「预算」之前，董事会逐项质询了增幅超过百分之十的科目。

words.enDefinition: the difference between budgeted and actual results

examples.en: The report shows a favourable budget variance on materials but an adverse one on freight.
examples.zh: 报告显示材料成本出现有利的「预算差异」，运费却出现了不利差异。

examples.en: Each department head signs off their budget variance and explains anything beyond five percent.
examples.zh: 各部门主管需确认本部门的「预算差异」，并说明超过百分之五的原因。

words.enDefinition: recording a cost as an asset rather than an immediate expense

examples.en: We agreed the capitalization threshold at five hundred pounds for small tools and equipment.
examples.zh: 我们把小型工具设备的「资本化」门槛定在了五百英镑。

examples.en: Development costs met the criteria, so capitalization was allowed once technical feasibility was proven.
examples.zh: 开发支出符合条件，技术可行性一旦验证，「资本化」便获准进行。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “capitalization” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied a capitalization to a short case study.

words.enDefinition: the amount at which an asset or liability is recognized after adjustments

examples.en: The machine's carrying amount is cost minus the accumulated depreciation shown in the ledger.
examples.zh: 机器的「账面金额」等于成本减去账上显示的累计折旧。

examples.en: Recoverable amount fell below carrying amount, so we recognised an impairment immediately.
examples.zh: 可收回金额跌破「账面金额」，我们立即确认了一项减值。

words.enDefinition: an organized list of all accounts used by an entity

examples.en: The intern set up the chart of accounts with a separate code for delivery costs.
examples.zh: 实习生搭建「会计科目表」时，专门为运费设了一个独立的科目编码。

examples.en: Group policy forbids adding accounts to the chart of accounts without head office approval.
examples.zh: 集团政策规定，未经总部批准不得在「会计科目表」中新增科目。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “chart of accounts” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the chart of accounts without reading the notes.

words.enDefinition: the balance of an account at the end of a reporting period

examples.en: The closing balance on the cash account agreed exactly with the bank statement.
examples.zh: 现金账户的「期末余额」与银行对账单完全一致。

examples.en: This year's closing balance becomes next year's opening figure without any adjustment.
examples.zh: 本年度的「期末余额」无需任何调整，直接结转为下年的期初数。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: The worksheet shows how the _____ affects the accounts.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “closing balance” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the closing balance affects the accounts.

words.enDefinition: an entry used to close temporary accounts at the end of an accounting period

examples.en: At year end I passed the closing entry that clears revenue into income summary.
examples.zh: 年末我编制了把收入转入收益汇总账户的「结账分录」。

examples.en: The system generates each closing entry automatically once we confirm the period end date.
examples.zh: 只要确认期末日期，系统就会自动生成每笔「结账分录」。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: The worksheet shows how the _____ affects the accounts.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the closing entry affects the accounts.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “closing entry” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the closing entry affects the accounts.

words.enDefinition: inventory held at the end of an accounting period

examples.en: Closing inventory was counted on the last Saturday of December by the whole warehouse team.
examples.zh: 「期末存货」由仓库全体成员在十二月的最后一个星期六盘点。

examples.en: Overstating closing inventory inflates this year's profit but quietly steals it from next year.
examples.zh: 高估「期末存货」会抬高今年的利润，却在不知不觉中透支了明年的利润。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “closing inventory” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Warehouse staff counted items linked to the closing inventory.

words.enDefinition: prior-period amount shown alongside current-period financial information

examples.en: Investors compare each comparative figure against the current column to spot the trend.
examples.zh: 投资者会将每个「比较数据」与本期数字对比，从中寻找趋势。

examples.en: When the prior year was restated, every comparative figure had to be relabelled too.
examples.zh: 前期数据重述后，所有「比较数据」也必须相应重新标注。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: The worksheet shows how the _____ affects the accounts.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “comparative figure” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the comparative figure affects the accounts.

words.enDefinition: audit evidence obtained by requesting information directly from an external party

examples.en: The confirmation letter went directly to the bank, with our client never touching it.
examples.zh: 「函证」直接寄给了银行，全程不经过客户之手。

examples.en: Only two customers replied to the confirmation, so we widened the sample and re-sent.
examples.zh: 只有两位客户回复了「函证」，于是我们扩大样本重新发出。

usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Working papers explain how we tested the confirmation.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “confirmation” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Working papers explain how we tested the confirmation.

words.enDefinition: sales revenue minus variable costs; the amount available to cover fixed costs and profit

examples.en: Each sandwich sells for four pounds with a contribution margin of one pound sixty.
examples.zh: 每份三明治卖四英镑，「边际贡献」为一英镑六十便士。

examples.en: Once fixed costs are covered, every extra pound of contribution margin drops straight into profit.
examples.zh: 固定成本一旦覆盖，每多出一英镑的「边际贡献」都直接变成利润。

examples.en: In class we applied a corporate tax to a short case study.

words.enDefinition: the process of assigning costs to products, departments, or other cost objects

examples.en: Rent is shared across the three workshops using floor space as the cost allocation basis.
examples.zh: 三个车间分摊租金时，以占地面积作为「成本分配」的依据。

examples.en: We argued for hours over which cost allocation method best reflects what each product really uses.
examples.zh: 我们争论了好几个小时，到底哪种「成本分配」方法最能反映各产品的实际耗用。

words.enDefinition: factor that causes or influences the amount of a cost

examples.en: Machine hours turned out to be the real cost driver behind our repair bills.
examples.zh: 机器工时被证实是维修费用背后真正的「成本动因」。

examples.en: Once we identified number of orders as the cost driver, overhead allocation finally made sense.
examples.zh: 一旦确定订单数量为「成本动因」，间接费用的分配就终于说得通了。

words.enDefinition: the cost assigned to inventory that has been sold during the period

examples.en: Gross profit collapses when cost of goods sold rises faster than the shelf prices.
examples.zh: 当「销货成本」的涨幅超过标价涨幅时，毛利就会急剧萎缩。

examples.en: I added freight and purchase discounts into cost of goods sold before computing the ratio.
examples.zh: 计算比率之前，我把运费和购货折扣都计入了「销货成本」。

collocations: count the cost of goods sold
value the cost of goods sold
move the cost of goods sold

usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Warehouse staff counted items linked to the cost of goods sold.

words.enDefinition: the cost of goods or services sold during a period

examples.en: The franchise fee barely covers cost of sales, let alone the rent.
examples.zh: 特许费勉强够抵「销售成本」，更不用说房租了。

examples.en: Service firms report cost of sales differently, often as staff time charged to jobs.
examples.zh: 服务企业的「销售成本」列报方式不同，通常是计入项目的员工工时。

words.enDefinition: an accounting entry recorded on the right side of an account

examples.en: Every credit entry needs an equal debit somewhere, or the books simply refuse to balance.
examples.zh: 每一笔「贷方」记录都必须有等额的借方对应，否则账簿根本无法平衡。

examples.en: The trainee posted the refund on the wrong side, debiting where a credit belonged.
examples.zh: 实习生把退款记错了方向，本该记「贷方」的地方记成了借方。

words.enDefinition: document reducing the amount a customer owes, often after a return or adjustment

examples.en: The customer returned four damaged chairs, so we issued a credit note the same day.
examples.zh: 客户退回了四把损坏的椅子，我们当天就开具了「贷项通知单」。

examples.en: Please quote the original invoice number whenever you raise a credit note in the system.
examples.zh: 在系统中开具「贷项通知单」时，请务必注明原发票号码。

words.enDefinition: purchase in which payment is made at a later date

examples.en: The flour was a credit purchase, payable thirty days after the delivery note was signed.
examples.zh: 这批面粉是「赊购」来的，签收送货单后三十天付款。

examples.en: Our supplier balances grew while cash stayed untouched, thanks entirely to credit purchases.
examples.zh: 多亏全是「赊购」，供应商挂账越来越多，现金却一分未动。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “credit purchase” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied a credit purchase to a short case study.

words.enDefinition: sale in which the customer is allowed to pay later

examples.en: Every credit sale adds a customer receivable and a little extra credit risk for us.
examples.zh: 每做一笔「赊销」，我们就会多一笔客户应收款，也多一分信用风险。

examples.en: Revenue is recognised when the credit sale is agreed, not when the cash finally lands.
examples.zh: 「赊销」在成交时即确认收入，而不是等现金真正到账。

usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the credit sale affects the accounts.

words.enDefinition: an asset that is cash or a cash equivalent, held for trading, expected to be realised within twelve months after the reporting period, or expected to be realised, sold, or consumed in the normal operating cycle

examples.en: Inventory, receivables, and bank balances are the classic examples of a current asset.
examples.zh: 存货、应收款项和银行存款都是「流动资产」的典型例子。

examples.en: The bank asked whether we could turn every current asset into cash within three months.
examples.zh: 银行询问我们能否在三个月内把所有「流动资产」变现。

collocations: current assets on the statement of financial position

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: Inventory is usually presented as a _____ because it is consumed in the operating cycle.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Inventory is usually presented as a current asset because it is consumed in the operating cycle.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “current asset” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Inventory is usually presented as a current asset because it is consumed in the operating cycle.

words.enDefinition: a liability that is expected to be settled in the normal operating cycle, held primarily for trading, due within twelve months after the reporting period, or for which the entity does not have the right at the reporting date to defer settlement for at least twelve months

examples.en: Our current liability total jumped once the short-term loan was classified as repayable on demand.
examples.zh: 那笔短期贷款一经划为可随时偿还，「流动负债」总额便大幅跳升。

examples.en: Suppliers due within ninety days sit under current liability, while term loans sit below.
examples.zh: 九十天内到期的供应商款项归入「流动负债」，长期贷款则列在其下方。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: Trade payables are normally classified as a _____.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Trade payables are normally classified as a current liability.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “current liability” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Trade payables are normally classified as a current liability.

words.enDefinition: current assets divided by current liabilities, used to assess short-term liquidity

examples.en: A current ratio below one means short-term debts outweigh everything we could quickly sell.
examples.zh: 「流动比率」低于一，意味着短期债务超过了所有能快速变现的资产。

examples.en: Lenders want a current ratio of at least one and a half before approving overdrafts.
examples.zh: 银行要求「流动比率」至少达到一点五，才考虑批准透支额度。

words.enDefinition: tax payable or recoverable for the current reporting period

examples.en: Current tax for the year is estimated on taxable profits before the final figures arrive.
examples.zh: 在最终数字出来之前，本年度「当期所得税」按应税利润暂估。

examples.en: Deferred tax balances the timing differences, while current tax covers what is actually owed now.
examples.zh: 递延所得税平衡时间性差异，「当期所得税」则反映当前实际应缴的部分。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “current tax” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied a current tax to a short case study.

words.enDefinition: an accounting entry recorded on the left side of an account

examples.en: Purchases go on the debit side of the supplier account until payment clears.
examples.zh: 在款项结清之前，采购都记在供应商账户的「借方」。

examples.en: A suspense debit sat untouched for weeks until we finally traced the mystery payment.
examples.zh: 那笔待查的「借方」挂了几周，直到我们终于查清了这笔神秘付款。

words.enDefinition: document notifying another party of an amount to be debited or adjusted

examples.en: We sent the supplier a debit note charging them for the two broken pallets.
examples.zh: 我们给供应商开了「借项通知单」，就两个破损托盘向他们收费。

examples.en: The buyer raised a debit note for the price difference instead of waiting for a refund.
examples.zh: 买方就差价开具了「借项通知单」，而不是干等着对方退款。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “debit note” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the debit note affects the accounts.

words.enDefinition: cash received before the related revenue is earned

examples.en: Subscription money paid in January is deferred revenue until we actually deliver the issues.
examples.zh: 一月份收到的订阅款在刊物实际交付前都属于「递延收入」。

examples.en: As each training session runs, a slice of the deferred revenue moves into earned income.
examples.zh: 每完成一期培训，就有一部分「递延收入」转为已实现的收入。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: The worksheet shows how the _____ affects the accounts.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the deferred revenue affects the accounts.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “deferred revenue” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the deferred revenue affects the accounts.

words.enDefinition: tax effects arising from differences between accounting and tax bases

examples.en: Accelerated tax depreciation creates a deferred tax liability that reverses over the asset's life.
examples.zh: 税务上的加速折旧会产生「递延所得税」负债，并随资产使用年限逐步转回。

examples.en: The deferred tax note lists each timing difference and the rate applied to it.
examples.zh: 「递延所得税」附注逐项列示了各个时间性差异及其适用的税率。

words.enDefinition: the risk that audit procedures fail to detect an existing material misstatement

examples.en: Skipping confirmations raises detection risk because undetected errors slip straight into the opinion.
examples.zh: 跳过函证会抬高「检查风险」，未发现的错报会直接溜进审计意见里。

examples.en: More substantive testing is planned wherever the team judges detection risk to be unacceptably high.
examples.zh: 凡是团队判断「检查风险」高得不可接受的领域，都会安排更多实质性测试。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: The audit team sampled transactions related to the _____.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The audit team sampled transactions related to the detection risk.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “detection risk” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The audit team sampled transactions related to the detection risk.

words.enDefinition: cost that can be traced directly to a specific product, service, or cost object

examples.en: Timber and joiner wages are direct costs of every table the workshop ships.
examples.zh: 木材和木工工资是车间每张出货餐桌的「直接成本」。

examples.en: We price each bespoke job by totalling its direct cost and adding a margin.
examples.zh: 每个定制项目的报价，就是把「直接成本」加总后再加上利润率。

usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the direct cost affects the accounts.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “direct cost” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the direct cost affects the accounts.

words.enDefinition: labour cost that can be traced directly to producing a product or service

examples.en: Hours logged on each job card give us the direct labour charge for that order.
examples.zh: 每张工单记录的工时，就是我们给该订单计算「直接人工」的依据。

examples.en: Overtime spent reworking failed units still counts as direct labour, sadly for our margins.
examples.zh: 返工不合格品所花的加班费仍算「直接人工」，这让我们的利润率很受伤。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “direct labour” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the direct labour without reading the notes.

words.enDefinition: material cost that can be traced directly to a product

examples.en: Leather is the biggest direct material in every handbag we stitch.
examples.zh: 皮革是我们缝制的每一只手袋中最主要的「直接材料」。

examples.en: The pricing sheet splits each product into direct material, direct labour, and overhead.
examples.zh: 定价表把每个产品拆成「直接材料」、直接人工和间接费用三项。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: In class we applied a _____ to a short case study.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied a direct material to a short case study.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “direct material” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied a direct material to a short case study.

words.enDefinition: the sale, retirement, or removal of an asset from use

examples.en: After the disposal of the old press, the print room finally had space to breathe.
examples.zh: 旧印刷机「处置」之后，印刷车间总算有了喘息的空间。

examples.en: The gain or loss on disposal depends on how the proceeds compare with book value.
examples.zh: 「处置」产生的损益，取决于变卖所得与账面价值的比较结果。

usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Depreciation policy interacts with the disposal.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “disposal” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Depreciation policy interacts with the disposal.

words.enDefinition: system in which each transaction affects at least two accounts with equal debits and credits

examples.en: Double-entry bookkeeping means every pound leaving one account arrives in another, always in balance.
examples.zh: 「复式记账」意味着每一英镑离开一个账户，就必然进入另一个账户，永远保持平衡。

examples.en: Luca Pacioli formalised double-entry bookkeeping five centuries ago, yet small shops still follow his pattern.
examples.zh: 五个世纪前卢卡·帕乔利确立了「复式记账」，如今小店家依然沿用他的这套模式。

words.enDefinition: the residual interest in assets after liabilities are deducted

examples.en: After the bank loan is repaid, whatever remains belongs to the owners as equity.
examples.zh: 银行贷款偿还之后，剩下的都归属所有者，成为「所有者权益」。

examples.en: Retained profits accumulate in equity year after year unless the board declares dividends.
examples.zh: 只要董事会不宣告分红，留存利润就会年复一年地沉淀在「所有者权益」里。

words.enDefinition: cost consumed or incurred in generating revenue during a period

examples.en: The printer toner is an expense this month, but the printer itself is an asset.
examples.zh: 打印机墨盒本月算「费用」，但打印机本身是一项资产。

examples.en: Rent, insurance, and salaries all hit the expense line before profit can be computed.
examples.zh: 租金、保险和工资都要先计入「费用」，然后才能算出利润。

words.enDefinition: variance that improves profit relative to the standard or budget

examples.en: Bulk buying produced a favourable variance on materials that offset our freight overrun.
examples.zh: 大宗采购使材料出现「有利差异」，抵销了我们运费的超支。

examples.en: The manager suspects the favourable variance on wages came from cutting training hours.
examples.zh: 经理怀疑工资上的「有利差异」，是靠压缩培训时间换来的。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “favourable variance” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the favourable variance without reading the notes.

words.enDefinition: an inventory cost method assuming the earliest purchases are sold first

examples.en: Under FIFO, the winter coats bought cheaply in August are treated as sold first.
examples.zh: 在「先进先出法」下，八月低价购入的冬衣视为先售出。

examples.en: Switching to FIFO in a rising market pushes reported profit higher than weighted average.
examples.zh: 在上涨行情中改用「先进先出法」，报告利润会比加权平均法更高。

usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Warehouse staff counted items linked to the FIFO.

words.enDefinition: the final date by which a tax return or filing must be submitted

examples.en: The filing deadline for corporation tax is twelve months after the period ends.
examples.zh: 公司税的「申报截止日期」是会计期间结束后十二个月。

examples.en: We file early because missing the filing deadline brings an automatic penalty from HMRC.
examples.zh: 我们都提前申报，因为错过「申报截止日期」会被 HMRC 自动罚款。

usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the filing deadline without reading the notes.

words.enDefinition: formal report presenting an entity's financial position and performance

examples.en: Each financial statement tells a different story about the same business.
examples.zh: 每一份「财务报表」都在讲述同一家企业的不同侧面。

examples.en: Readers who skip the notes to the financial statement miss half the picture.
examples.zh: 跳过「财务报表」附注的读者，会漏掉一半的信息。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: I can now explain the _____ without reading the notes.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the financial statement without reading the notes.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “financial statement” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the financial statement without reading the notes.

words.enDefinition: an entity’s accounting and reporting period, normally about twelve months, used to prepare financial statements

examples.en: Our financial year runs from the first of April to the thirty-first of March.
examples.zh: 我们的「财务年度」从四月一日一直跑到次年三月三十一日。

examples.en: The company shortened its financial year to close at the same date as its parent.
examples.zh: 为了与母公司同期结账，公司缩短了本个「财务年度」。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: The company’s _____ ends on 31 December.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The company’s financial year ends on 31 December.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “financial year” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The company’s financial year ends on 31 December.

words.enDefinition: completed products ready for sale

examples.en: Finished goods stacked on pallets await the truck that leaves for Dublin each Friday.
examples.zh: 码在托盘上的「产成品」等着每周五发往都柏林的卡车。

examples.en: The costing sheet moves value from work in progress into finished goods as orders complete.
examples.zh: 订单完工时，成本单会把价值从在产品结转到「产成品」。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: Warehouse staff counted items linked to the _____.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Warehouse staff counted items linked to the finished goods.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “finished goods” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Warehouse staff counted items linked to the finished goods.

words.enDefinition: a cost that does not change with activity level in the short run

examples.en: Rent and insurance are fixed costs; they arrive whether we sell ten units or ten thousand.
examples.zh: 租金和保险是「固定成本」，无论卖十件还是一万件都照付不误。

examples.en: Spreading fixed costs over larger volumes is exactly why the factory pushed for export orders.
examples.zh: 用更大的产量摊薄「固定成本」，正是工厂拼命争取出口订单的原因。

words.enDefinition: transport cost incurred to bring purchased inventory to its location

examples.en: Freight-in on the imported tiles was added to inventory cost, not to selling expenses.
examples.zh: 进口瓷砖的「进货运费」计入了存货成本，而不是销售费用。

examples.en: Our supplier splits the invoice so freight-in appears as a separate line each month.
examples.zh: 供应商把发票拆开列示，「进货运费」每月都单独占一行。

usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the freight-in affects the accounts.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “freight-in” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the freight-in affects the accounts.

words.enDefinition: the profit recognized when disposal proceeds exceed the asset's carrying amount

examples.en: Selling the old lorry above book value produced a gain on disposal of eight hundred.
examples.zh: 那辆旧卡车卖价高于账面价值，产生了八百英镑的「处置收益」。

examples.en: The gain on disposal sits under other income, safely below the operating profit line.
examples.zh: 「处置收益」列在其他收益项下，稳稳落在营业利润线以下。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “gain on disposal” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Depreciation policy interacts with the gain on disposal.

words.enDefinition: chronological record used to enter accounting transactions

examples.en: Anything the special journals cannot capture lands in the general journal instead.
examples.zh: 凡是专用日记账装不下的业务，一律记入「普通日记账」。

examples.en: I recorded the depreciation correction in the general journal and cross-referenced the original voucher.
examples.zh: 我把折旧更正记入「普通日记账」，并交叉索引了原始凭证。

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “general journal” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the general journal without reading the notes.

words.enDefinition: the complete collection of an entity's accounting accounts

examples.en: Every subsidiary ledger rolls up into the general ledger before the trial balance is drawn.

examples.zh: 由于内部控制薄弱，我们几乎完全依赖对余额的「实质性测试」。

examples.en: Substantive testing confirmed that the receivables balance really existed and really belonged to us.
examples.zh: 「实质性测试」证实了应收款项余额真实存在，而且确实归我们所有。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: The worksheet shows how the _____ affects the accounts.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the substantive testing affects the accounts.

words.enDefinition: document providing evidence for an accounting transaction or balance

examples.en: Attach a supporting document to every expense claim before submitting it.
examples.zh: 每笔费用报销提交之前，都必须附上「支持性文件」。

examples.en: The auditor traced each cash payment back to its supporting document within minutes.
examples.zh: 审计员几分钟内就把每笔现金付款追溯到了对应的「支持性文件」。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: We reconciled the _____ to the supporting schedule.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: We reconciled the supporting document to the supporting schedule.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “supporting document” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: We reconciled the supporting document to the supporting schedule.

words.enDefinition: an amount that can be deducted or is exempt when calculating taxable income

examples.en: Claim the full tax allowance for equipment bought before the year-end deadline.
examples.zh: 年终截止日前购置的设备，可以全额申报「税收扣除额」。

examples.en: Her personal tax allowance rose this April, so more of her wages stay untaxed.
examples.zh: 今年四月她的个人「免税额」提高了，工资中有更多部分不用缴税。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: In class we applied a _____ to a short case study.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied a tax allowance to a short case study.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “tax allowance” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied a tax allowance to a short case study.

words.enDefinition: an official determination of tax liability

examples.en: The tax assessment arrived four months late and doubled our expected liability.
examples.zh: 「税务评估」迟了四个月才到，而且把我们的预计税负翻了一倍。

examples.en: We disputed the tax assessment by filing evidence of every deduction we claimed.
examples.zh: 我们提交了所申报各项扣除的证据，对「税务评估」提出了异议。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: I can now explain the _____ without reading the notes.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the tax assessment without reading the notes.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “tax assessment” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the tax assessment without reading the notes.

words.enDefinition: the amount attributed to an asset or liability for tax purposes

examples.en: The tax base of the machine is lower because tax depreciation runs faster.
examples.zh: 由于税务折旧更快，这台机器的「计税基础」低于账面价值。

examples.en: Compare each asset's carrying amount with its tax base to find the temporary difference.
examples.zh: 将每项资产的账面价值与其「计税基础」相比，就能找出暂时性差异。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: The tax team estimated the _____ for the return.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The tax team estimated the tax base for the return.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “tax base” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The tax team estimated the tax base for the return.

words.enDefinition: the process of meeting tax filing, payment, and record-keeping requirements

examples.en: The practice hires a specialist each summer purely to keep our tax compliance current.
examples.zh: 事务所每年夏天专门请一位专家，只为保证我们的「税务合规」不出纰漏。

examples.en: Tax compliance costs small firms real hours that big rivals simply automate away.
examples.zh: 「税务合规」消耗小企业大量实实在在的时间，大竞争对手们早就把这套流程自动化了。

words.enDefinition: an amount allowed to reduce taxable income

examples.en: Mileage between jobs qualifies as a tax deduction, but your commute never does.
examples.zh: 跑业务的路费可以作为「税前扣除」，但上下班的通勤永远不行。

examples.en: Every tax deduction we claim is filed with its receipt inside the same folder.
examples.zh: 我们申报的每一项「税前扣除」，都连同票据收在同一份文件夹里。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: I can now explain the _____ without reading the notes.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the tax deduction without reading the notes.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “tax deduction” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the tax deduction without reading the notes.

words.enDefinition: the amount of tax recognized as an expense in financial reporting

examples.en: This year's tax expense fell because earlier losses finally sheltered part of the profit.
examples.zh: 以前的亏损终于抵掉了一部分利润，今年的「所得税费用」随之下降。

examples.en: The tax expense line combines current tax and any movement in deferred tax.
examples.zh: 「所得税费用」一行由当期所得税和递延所得税变动合并而成。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: Supporting workings for the _____ were filed with the pack.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Supporting workings for the tax expense were filed with the pack.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “tax expense” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Supporting workings for the tax expense were filed with the pack.

words.enDefinition: tax that is due to the tax authority

examples.en: Our tax payable account cleared the day the direct debit finally went through.
examples.zh: 直接扣款终于划走的那天，我们的「应交税费」账户清零了。

examples.en: Estimate tax payable each quarter so the January bill never surprises the cash flow.
examples.zh: 每季度都估算「应交税费」，一月份的税单就再也不会吓到现金流。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: Supporting workings for the _____ were filed with the pack.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Supporting workings for the tax payable were filed with the pack.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “tax payable” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Supporting workings for the tax payable were filed with the pack.

words.enDefinition: lawful planning of transactions to manage tax consequences

examples.en: Careful tax planning moved the equipment purchase into April, spreading the relief over two years.
examples.zh: 精心的「税务筹划」把设备采购挪到四月，让税收优惠分摊到两个年度。

examples.en: Legitimate tax planning is fine; disguising income is what gets companies fined.
examples.zh: 正当的「税务筹划」没有问题，掩饰收入才会让公司挨罚。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: The worksheet shows how the _____ affects the accounts.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the tax planning affects the accounts.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “tax planning” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The worksheet shows how the tax planning affects the accounts.

words.enDefinition: the percentage at which a tax is applied

examples.en: The small profits tax rate drops to nineteen percent for companies under the threshold.
examples.zh: 对门槛以下的公司，小利润「税率」降至百分之十九。

examples.en: When the tax rate changes, every deferred tax balance gets remeasured the same day.
examples.zh: 「税率」一旦变动，所有递延所得税余额当天都要重新计量。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: In class we applied a _____ to a short case study.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied a tax rate to a short case study.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “tax rate” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied a tax rate to a short case study.

words.enDefinition: money returned because tax paid exceeded the final liability

examples.en: The tax refund arrived in May and covered the accountant's entire fee.
examples.zh: 五月「退税」到账，刚好付清了会计师的全部费用。

examples.en: We overpaid through the payroll error, so the tax refund was genuinely ours.
examples.zh: 工资单出错导致我们多缴了税，这笔「退税」本来就该归我们。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: I can now explain the _____ without reading the notes.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the tax refund without reading the notes.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “tax refund” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: I can now explain the tax refund without reading the notes.

words.enDefinition: form used to report taxable income and calculate tax due

examples.en: My tax return is due by the thirty-first of January, online only.
examples.zh: 我的「纳税申报表」一月底前截止，而且只能在线提交。

examples.en: Keep every receipt for six years after the tax return, in case of an inquiry.
examples.zh: 「纳税申报表」提交后，所有票据还要再保存六年，以备稽查。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: Supporting workings for the _____ were filed with the pack.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Supporting workings for the tax return were filed with the pack.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “tax return” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Supporting workings for the tax return were filed with the pack.

words.enDefinition: income subject to tax after applying relevant tax rules and adjustments

examples.en: Depreciation is added back, then capital allowances deducted, to reach taxable income.
examples.zh: 先加回折旧，再扣除资本减免，就得出「应税所得」。

examples.en: Her taxable income sits just below the higher-rate band after pension contributions.
examples.zh: 扣除养老金缴费后，她的「应税所得」刚好落在高税率档之下。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: In class we applied _____ to a short case study.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied taxable income to a short case study.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “taxable income” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: In class we applied taxable income to a short case study.

words.enDefinition: difference between an asset or liability's carrying amount and tax base

examples.en: The temporary difference reverses once the tax office allows the accelerated depreciation to unwind.
examples.zh: 等加速折旧的税务优惠逐步退坡，「暂时性差异」就会转回。

examples.en: Every temporary difference in the schedule is multiplied by the expected future tax rate.
examples.zh: 明细表中的每一项「暂时性差异」都要乘以预计的未来税率。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: The tax team estimated the _____ for the return.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The tax team estimated the temporary difference for the return.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “temporary difference” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The tax team estimated the temporary difference for the return.

words.enDefinition: list of ledger account balances used to check debit and credit equality

examples.en: If the trial balance refuses to agree, some entry is hiding a transposition.
examples.zh: 如果「试算平衡表」两边合不拢，那一定是某笔分录把数字颠倒了。

examples.en: The trial balance proves debits equal credits, though it cannot prove every entry is correct.
examples.zh: 「试算平衡表」能证明借贷相等，却不能证明每笔记录都正确。

words.enDefinition: the period over which an asset is expected to be available for use by an entity, or the number of production or similar units expected to be obtained from the asset

examples.en: The kitchen redefined its ovens' useful life at eight years after the service overhaul.
examples.zh: 大修之后，后厨把烤箱的「使用寿命」重新定为八年。

examples.en: An asset's useful life may be measured in units produced rather than in years.
examples.zh: 资产的「使用寿命」可以按产量计量，而不一定按年数计。

collocations: useful life in units of production

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: Management revised the _____ of the machine after a technical review.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Management revised the useful life of the machine after a technical review.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “useful life” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Management revised the useful life of the machine after a technical review.

words.enDefinition: a cost that varies in proportion to activity or output

examples.en: Ingredients are our main variable cost, moving almost perfectly with every pizza sold.
examples.zh: 食材是我们最主要的「变动成本」，几乎随每张披萨的售出同步变动。

examples.en: Price above variable cost and every sale chips away at the fixed costs.
examples.zh: 只要定价高于「变动成本」，每笔销售都在慢慢啃掉固定成本。

words.enDefinition: an inventory cost formula that averages the cost of similar items on hand at the beginning of the period and those purchased or produced during the period, weighted by quantity (IAS 2)

examples.en: Each delivery is averaged into the weighted average cost before the next sale prices out.
examples.zh: 每批进货都先并入「加权平均成本」，然后才对下一笔销售计价。

examples.en: Bakeries like weighted average cost because flour arrives weekly at a different price.
examples.zh: 面包房偏爱「加权平均成本」，因为面粉每周到货的价钱都不一样。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: Under the _____ formula, opening inventory and purchases are averaged by quantity.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Under the weighted average cost formula, opening inventory and purchases are averaged by quantity.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “weighted average cost” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Under the weighted average cost formula, opening inventory and purchases are averaged by quantity.

words.enDefinition: tax deducted from a payment before the recipient receives it

examples.en: The overseas client deducted withholding tax before wiring our consulting fee.
examples.zh: 海外客户在汇出咨询费之前，先扣掉了一笔「预扣税」。

examples.en: We claim the withholding tax back as a credit under the double-tax treaty.
examples.zh: 依据双边税收协定，我们用抵免方式申请退回那笔「预扣税」。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: The tax team estimated the _____ for the return.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The tax team estimated the withholding tax for the return.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “withholding tax” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: The tax team estimated the withholding tax for the return.

words.enDefinition: partially completed goods still in the production process

examples.en: Chairs waiting for varnish sit in work in progress until the finisher signs off.
examples.zh: 等待上漆的椅子暂列「在产品」，直到油漆工签收完工。

examples.en: Valuing work in progress needs an estimate of how far each batch has travelled.
examples.zh: 给「在产品」计价，需要估计每批产品已完成的工序进度。

usagePrompts.prompt: Complete: Costing changed after we updated the _____.
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Costing changed after we updated the work in progress.

usagePrompts.prompt: 用 “work in progress” 写一句你真实会说的话。
usagePrompts.modelAnswer: Costing changed after we updated the work in progress.

words.enDefinition: ledger recording each stockholder's shareholdings

examples.en: The company secretary updates the stockholder's ledger whenever shares change hands.
examples.zh: 每当股份易手，公司秘书都会更新「股东分户账」。

examples.en: A dispute over voting rights was settled by tracing entries in the stockholder's ledger.
examples.zh: 一场投票权之争，最终靠追查「股东分户账」的记录得以解决。

words.enDefinition: stock warrants that remain outstanding

examples.en: Diluted earnings per share must count all stock warrants outstanding from the convertible loan.
examples.zh: 计算稀释每股收益时，必须把可转债附带的全部「流通在外认股权证」算进去。

examples.en: Exercise of stock warrants outstanding would raise fresh cash but dilute the founder's control.
examples.zh: 「流通在外认股权证」一旦行权会带来新资金，但也会稀释创始人的控制权。

words.enDefinition: customs duty imposed mainly to raise government revenue

examples.en: The levy on imported coffee is a revenue duty, set simply to fill the treasury.
examples.zh: 对进口咖啡征收的税是「财政关税」，设立的目的就是充实国库。

examples.en: Unlike protective tariffs, a revenue duty stays low enough to keep trade flowing.
examples.zh: 与保护性关税不同，「财政关税」保持低位，以便贸易照常流动。

words.enDefinition: amounts a business owes to suppliers for goods or services received

examples.en: Open an account payable entry the day the goods arrive, not when the invoice does.
examples.zh: 货物一到达就要开立「应付账款」记录，而不是等发票到了再记。

examples.en: Each account payable carries its due date so cash is never paid away early.
examples.zh: 每一笔「应付账款」都标注到期日，保证现金绝不提前流出。

words.enDefinition: sale intended to clear remaining stock at reduced prices

examples.en: January's clearance sales emptied the warehouse of last season's camping gear.
examples.zh: 一月的「清仓甩卖」把仓库里上季的露营装备一扫而空。

examples.en: Accounting-wise, clearance sales still bring revenue even when every item goes at a loss.
examples.zh: 从会计角度看，「清仓甩卖」即使件件亏本也照样确认收入。

words.enDefinition: the United States federal tax authority (IRS)

examples.en: The internal revenue service publishes updated withholding tables every December.
examples.zh: 「国内税务局」每年十二月都会发布最新的预扣税率表。

examples.en: My cousin works for the internal revenue service auditing small-business returns in Ohio.
examples.zh: 我表姐在「国内税务局」工作，负责稽查俄亥俄州小企业的申报表。

words.enDefinition: the grouping of accounts into classes in a chart of accounts

examples.en: Clear classification of accounts keeps every asset, liability, and income item in its own family.
examples.zh: 清晰的「账户分类」让每项资产、负债和收益科目都各归其类。

examples.en: The trainee mixed prepayments with payables until the supervisor redid the classification of accounts.
examples.zh: 实习生把预付和应付混在一起，直到主管重做了「账户分类」。

words.enDefinition: lien on inventory as security for a debt

examples.en: The bank holds an inventory lien on every crate of stock it financed.
examples.zh: 银行对其融资的每一箱存货都设有「存货留置权」。

examples.en: We could not sell the bonded wine because the lender's inventory lien had priority.
examples.zh: 因为贷款人的「存货留置权」优先，我们无法出售那批保税葡萄酒。

words.enDefinition: an audit that is optional rather than legally required

examples.en: As a private company we commission an optional audit each year to reassure the bank.
examples.zh: 我们是私营公司，每年自行安排一次「随意审计」，好让银行放心。

examples.en: Because no statute demanded it, the family business treated the optional audit as pure reassurance.
examples.zh: 由于法律并无强制要求，家族企业只把「随意审计」当作纯粹的安心举措。

words.enDefinition: accounting for the value of human resources as assets

examples.en: Human asset accounting would treat trained staff as an asset instead of an expense.
examples.zh: 「人力资产会计」主张把受过培训的员工记作资产，而不是费用。

examples.en: Critics argue human asset accounting values people who could simply walk away tomorrow.
examples.zh: 批评者认为，「人力资产会计」把明天就可能离职的人算成了价值。

collocations: tie out the human asset accounting

words.enDefinition: loss of revenue over a short period

examples.en: Closing for the refit means a short-term revenue loss we have budgeted to survive.
examples.zh: 停业装修意味着一笔「短期收入损失」，我们已在预算中安排好如何扛过去。

examples.en: The recall caused a short-term revenue loss, but customer trust recovered within two quarters.
examples.zh: 召回带来了「短期收入损失」，不过两个季度内客户信任就恢复了。

words.enDefinition: income credits that are recognized later than the related cash or billing

examples.en: Subscription prepayments sit as delayed income credits until each issue actually ships.
examples.zh: 订阅预付款在每期杂志实际寄出前，都挂作「递延收益贷项」。

examples.en: At year end we released half of the delayed income credits tied to completed milestones.
examples.zh: 年末，我们把与已完成里程碑挂钩的一半「递延收益贷项」转为收入。

words.enDefinition: an associate-grade membership of a chartered accountancy body

examples.en: After passing the intermediate exams she was admitted as an associate of chartered accountants.
examples.zh: 通过中级考试后，她获准成为「特许会计师准会员」。

examples.en: The letters ACA behind his name mean associate of chartered accountants, a full member.
examples.zh: 他姓名后面的 ACA 三个字母代表「特许会计师准会员」，是正式会员资格。

words.enDefinition: your basis for belief or disbelief; knowledge on which to base belief

examples.en: Signed delivery notes are the evidence a court will actually accept.
examples.zh: 签过字的送货单才是法庭真正认可的「证据」。

examples.en: Without evidence of approval, the payments simply look like someone's private spending.
examples.zh: 缺少审批的「证据」，这些付款看上去就像某人的私人开销。

words.enDefinition: the state of being retired from one's business or occupation

examples.en: The senior partner's retirement left the firm without its best tax specialist.
examples.zh: 高级合伙人的「退休」让事务所失去了最好的税务专家。

examples.en: She saved into the pension scheme for thirty years before her retirement last spring.
examples.zh: 她向养老金计划存了三十年的钱，才在去年春天迎来「退休」。

words.enDefinition: profit remaining after expenses; a company's earnings

examples.en: Quarterly earnings beat forecasts, so the share price jumped before lunch.
examples.zh: 季度「盈利」超出预期，股价午饭前就跳涨了。

examples.en: Growth in earnings means little if the cash never actually reaches the bank.
examples.zh: 如果现金从未真正进账，「盈利」增长再多也意义有限。

words.enDefinition: someone who maintains and audits business accounts

examples.en: Our accountant flagged the missing receipts before the tax office ever asked.
examples.zh: 还没等税务局来问，我们的「会计师」就先发现了缺失的票据。

examples.en: The accountant reconciled the whole year in one weekend because the records were tidy.
examples.zh: 凭着整洁的账目记录，「会计师」一个周末就把全年账目对平了。

words.enDefinition: charge (a person or a property) with a payment, such as a tax or a fine

examples.en: The council assessed the property at a higher value, so the rates rose sharply.
examples.zh: 当局对该物业重新「评定税额」，结果地方税一下子涨了不少。

examples.en: HMRC can assess additional tax up to twenty years after a fraudulent return.
examples.zh: 只要申报涉假，HMRC 在二十年之后仍可补「评定税额」。

words.enDefinition: the imposition of taxes; the practice of the government in levying taxes on the subjects of a state

examples.en: Double taxation treaties stop the same profits being taxed in two countries.
examples.zh: 双边税收协定避免了同一笔利润在两国被重复「征税」。

examples.en: The seminar compared taxation of wages with taxation of dividends for owner-managers.
examples.zh: 研讨会上比较了经营者领取工资与分得股利两种方式下的「征税」差异。

words.enDefinition: (of an amount) owed and required to be paid

examples.en: Half the invoice is payable on order and half on delivery.
examples.zh: 发票金额一半在订货时「应付」，一半在交货时支付。

examples.en: Interest is payable quarterly, so mark the March, June, September, and December dates.
examples.zh: 利息按季度「应付」，记得把三月、六月、九月和十二月的日期标出来。

words.enDefinition: the occupation of maintaining and auditing records and preparing financial reports for a business

examples.en: She left accountancy for teaching after twelve years of busy season pressure.
examples.zh: 受够了十二年的忙季压力，她离开「会计工作」改行教书。

examples.en: Good accountancy is invisible when it works; you only notice it when something breaks.
examples.zh: 「会计工作」做得好时毫不起眼，只有出了纰漏才会被注意到。

words.enDefinition: impossible or nearly impossible to see; imperceptible by the eye

examples.en: The mended crack is invisible once the wall has been repainted.
examples.zh: 墙面重新粉刷之后，修补过的裂缝就「看不见」了。

examples.en: Security ink makes the signature invisible until you shine the special lamp on it.
examples.zh: 防伪墨水写下的签名要用专门的灯照才会显形，平时完全「看不见」。

words.enDefinition: to check that two sets of records agree and explain any differences between them

examples.en: I reconcile the till against the daily report before locking up each night.
examples.zh: 每晚锁门前，我都会把收银机的现金与日报「对帐」。

examples.en: The bank feed lets us reconcile supplier accounts in minutes instead of hours.
examples.zh: 有了银行流水接口，我们几分钟就能把供应商账户「对帐」完毕，不用再耗上几小时。

words.enDefinition: high standing achieved through success or influence or wealth etc.

examples.en: Winning the audit of the football club brought the firm real prestige.
examples.zh: 赢得足球俱乐部的审计业务，为事务所带来了实实在在的「声望」。

examples.en: The qualification carries prestige, yet starting salaries in the region stay modest.
examples.zh: 这张资格证书很有「声望」，但该地区的起薪依然不高。

words.enDefinition: payment to the holder of a patent or copyright or resource for the right to use their property

examples.en: Every ebook sold earns the author a royalty of about seventy percent.
examples.zh: 每售出一本电子书，作者都能拿到约七成的「特许权使用费」（版税）。

examples.en: The band still collects a royalty whenever a streaming service plays their old records.
examples.zh: 每当流媒体播放乐队的老唱片，他们仍会收到一笔「特许权使用费」。

words.enDefinition: liable to account for one's actions

examples.en: One named clerk is accountable for every key in the building.
examples.zh: 指定了专人，对大楼里的每一把钥匙「负有责任」。

examples.en: Managers are accountable for expenses incurred by their teams, so approvals get taken seriously.
examples.zh: 经理要对团队的费用开支「负有责任」，因此审批再也不敢马虎。

words.enDefinition: record in which commercial accounts are recorded

examples.en: Post every cash sale to the ledger before you close the shop.
examples.zh: 打烊之前，要把每笔现金销售都过入「分类账」。

examples.en: The clerk copies each day's figures into the ledger in neat black ink.
examples.zh: 书记员用工整的黑墨水把每天的数据誊进「分类账」。

words.enDefinition: document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts

examples.en: The auditor asked to see her credentials before letting her near the files.
examples.zh: 审计员核验了她的「凭证」（资历证明），才让她接触档案。

examples.en: A forged credential nearly landed the firm with a very costly hire.
examples.zh: 一份伪造的「凭证」差点让公司付出惨痛的招聘代价。

words.enDefinition: tax excessively

examples.en: Economists warned the treasury would overtax small traders and drive them informal.
examples.zh: 经济学家警告，财政部门若对小商贩「抽税过重」，会逼他们转入地下经营。

examples.en: The protest grew because drivers felt the new levy overtaxed an already squeezed trade.
examples.zh: 抗议愈演愈烈，因为司机们觉得新税费让本已艰难度日的行业「抽税过重」。

words.enDefinition: (of goods or funds) subject to taxation

examples.en: Free gifts to staff can still be taxable benefits worth reporting each year.
examples.zh: 给员工的免费赠品仍可能是「可征税的」福利，每年都值得申报。

examples.en: Only the first thirty pounds is taxable; the rest stays within the allowance.
examples.zh: 只有头三十英镑「可征税」，其余部分都在免税额度之内。

words.enDefinition: one (as a retailer or distributor) that stocks goods

examples.en: Ask your local stockist; most garden centres keep the larger pots in spring.
examples.zh: 请向当地的「存货商」询问，多数园艺中心春天都备有大号花盆。

examples.en: The brand appoints one official stockist per county to keep prices steady.
examples.zh: 该品牌每个郡只指定一家官方「存货商」，以维持价格稳定。

words.enDefinition: receiving a salary

examples.en: Salaried staff keep the same pay even when the workshop runs quiet.
examples.zh: 车间再清闲，「有薪金的」正式员工工资照拿不变。

examples.en: The firm prefers a salaried controller to hourly bookkeeping, whatever the overtime.
examples.zh: 无论加多少班，公司都宁可雇「有薪金的」主计长，也不用按小时计酬的簿记员。

words.enDefinition: someone who maintains and audits business accounts

examples.en: The comptroller signs every cheque above five thousand before it leaves the office.
examples.zh: 超过五千英镑的支票，都要经「主计长」签字后才能离开办公室。

examples.en: Our comptroller doubles as company secretary, which saves the board one salary.
examples.zh: 我们的「主计长」兼任公司秘书，为董事会省下了一份薪水。

words.enDefinition: someone who records the transactions of a business

examples.en: The bookkeeper catches duplicated invoices that the software's own checks keep missing.
examples.zh: 系统自检反复漏掉的重复发票，都被「簿记员」一一揪了出来。

examples.en: A careful bookkeeper is worth more to a corner shop than any accounting suite.
examples.zh: 对街角小店来说，一位细心的「簿记员」比任何会计软件都更值钱。

words.enDefinition: relatively small amount of money given for services rendered (as by a waiter)

examples.en: Service is included, so you never need to add a gratuity at this hotel.
examples.zh: 这家酒店已含服务费，无须再另付「小费」。

examples.en: The courier refused the gratuity, saying doing the job properly was simply his work.
examples.zh: 快递员婉拒了「小费」，说把活干好本来就是分内之事。

words.enDefinition: tax levied on the basis of a fixed amount per person

examples.en: The clinic charges a capitation fee of twenty pounds per registered patient.
examples.zh: 这家诊所按登记病人收取每人二十英镑的「按人计算」费用。

examples.en: Capitation funds schools by headcount, so losing thirty pupils costs real money.
examples.zh: 「按人计算」的经费按学生人数拨款给学校，流失三十名学生就是实实在在的损失。

words.enDefinition: towards the inside or centre of something

examples.en: The office door opens inwards, so we mounted the coat hooks inside the frame.
examples.zh: 办公室的门是「向内」开的，所以我们把挂衣钩装在了门框内侧。

examples.en: Fold the flaps inwards first, then the parcel closes flat without extra tape.
examples.zh: 先把纸板折页「向内」折，包裹就能平整合上，不用多缠胶带。

words.enDefinition: manifesting partiality

examples.en: Long-standing clients enjoy preferential rates on every audit they refer to us.
examples.zh: 老客户给我们转介的每一单审计都享受「特惠的」费率。

examples.en: The bank offered preferential terms because our accounts had been flawless for years.
examples.zh: 由于我们多年账目无可挑剔，银行给出了「特惠的」贷款条件。

words.enDefinition: the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), a multilateral trade agreement (1947; updated as GATT 1994) that governed much of world trade before and within the WTO framework — not a United Nations agency
acceptedEnVariants: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade

examples.en: Tariff schedules under GATT were negotiated in rounds lasting years at a time.
examples.zh: 「关税与贸易总协定」下的关税税则要经过历时数年的多轮谈判确定。

examples.en: Our lecturer traced how GATT 1994 folded the old agreement into the WTO system.
examples.zh: 老师梳理了「关税与贸易总协定」1994年版本如何把旧协定并入 WTO 体系。

words.enDefinition: the cost of stockholding

examples.en: Insurance, storage, and spoilage all feed into the stockholding cost of brewed beer.
examples.zh: 保险、仓储和损耗都计入酿造啤酒的「库存持有成本」。

examples.en: The buyer orders weekly now, because the stockholding cost outweighs the bulk discount.
examples.zh: 采购员现在改为每周下单，因为「库存持有成本」已经超过了批量折扣。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of salaries and wages

examples.en: Salaries and wages payable at December include the holiday pay earned but untaken.
examples.zh: 十二月的「应付薪金及工资」包含已挣得但尚未休假的工资折算。

examples.en: The audit team vouched salaries and wages payable against the signed payroll register.
examples.zh: 审计小组把「应付薪金及工资」与签核的工资登记簿逐项核对。

collocations: sample the salaries and wages payable
vouch the salaries and wages payable
tie out the salaries and wages payable

words.enDefinition: accounting for advanced cost

examples.en: Advanced cost accounting covered standard costing and variance analysis in the final term.
examples.zh: 「高级成本会计」课程在最后一学期讲授标准成本法和差异分析。

examples.en: Her dissertation on advanced cost accounting examined waste tracking in a Sheffield foundry.
examples.zh: 她的「高级成本会计」论文研究的是谢菲尔德一家铸造厂的废品追踪。

collocations: tie out the advanced cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage accounting cost

examples.en: Monthly variance reports are the backbone of our accounting cost control system.
examples.zh: 月度差异报告是我们「会计成本控制」体系的支柱。

examples.en: The group introduced accounting cost control after the takeaway chain quietly lost thousands on packaging.
examples.zh: 连锁外卖店在包装上悄然损失数千英镑后，集团引入了「会计成本控制」。

collocations: tie out the accounting cost control

words.enDefinition: an audit of stores

examples.en: The stores audit found nine drill bits recorded but missing from rack four.
examples.zh: 「仓库审计」发现九枚钻头账上有记录，四号货架上却找不到。

examples.en: During the stores audit, two assistants matched every bin card against the ledger.
examples.zh: 「仓库审计」期间，两名助理把每张料位卡与分类账逐一核对。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for net invoice

examples.en: Trade discounts come off first, and the net invoice price is what we record.
examples.zh: 先扣除商业折扣，然后按「净发票价格」入账。

examples.en: The catalogue shows list prices, but our net invoice price runs about twelve percent lower.
examples.zh: 目录上印的是定价，而我们的「净发票价格」大约低百分之十二。

words.enDefinition: a recurring sequence related to cost accounting

examples.en: The cost accounting cycle repeats monthly: collect, allocate, report, then compare with standards.
examples.zh: 「成本会计循环」每月重复一轮：归集、分配、编报，然后与标准对比。

examples.en: Students map the cost accounting cycle from purchase order to finished goods before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前，学生们把「成本会计循环」从采购订单到产成品的流程绘制成图。

words.enDefinition: accounting that records, classifies, and analyses the costs of products or activities

examples.en: Cost accounting told us which of the three cake lines actually made money.
examples.zh: 「成本会计」告诉我们，三条蛋糕产品线中究竟哪条真正赚钱。

examples.en: Without cost accounting, the factory had priced its cheapest product below bare materials.
examples.zh: 在没有「成本会计」之前，工厂把自己最便宜的产品定到了连材料费都不够的价位。

words.enDefinition: accounting for controlling-company

examples.en: Controlling-company accounting consolidates each subsidiary's trial balance into the group figures.
examples.zh: 「总公司会计」把各子公司的试算平衡表合并成集团数据。

examples.en: Inter-company sales are stripped out under controlling-company accounting before the group statements are struck.
examples.zh: 编制集团报表之前，「总公司会计」会先剔除公司之间的销售。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of profit sharing bonuses

examples.en: Profit sharing bonuses payable appear as a current liability until the cheques clear.
examples.zh: 「应付利润分红」在支票兑付之前列作流动负债。

examples.en: The scheme sets profit sharing bonuses payable once pre-tax profit passes two hundred thousand.
examples.zh: 税前利润一旦超过二十万，方案即触发「应付利润分红」的计提。

words.enDefinition: a cost not paid in cash but assigned for decision-making, such as the owner's own unpaid labour

examples.en: The owner's unpaid labour is an imputed cost the profit statement never shows.
examples.zh: 业主自己的无薪劳动是一种「推算成本」，利润表上从来看不到。

examples.en: Economists add imputed cost of owner-occupied premises when comparing the two shop locations.
examples.zh: 比较两家店铺选址时，经济学家会把自有门店的「推算成本」也加进来。

words.enDefinition: accounting for operational

examples.en: Operational accounting tracks daily throughput so managers see problems within the same week.
examples.zh: 「经营会计学」追踪每日产出，让经理在同一周内就能看到问题。

examples.en: She credits operational accounting with saving the bakery, because flour waste halved within months.
examples.zh: 她把面包房的起死回生归功于「经营会计学」，几个月内面粉浪费就减半了。

words.enDefinition: records of payroll amounts and deductions

examples.en: Payroll records for the past six years still sit in the locked cabinet.
examples.zh: 过去六年的「工资簿」仍锁在档案柜里。

examples.en: The inspector asked for payroll records covering every casual worker hired since March.
examples.zh: 稽查员要求提供自三月以来雇用的每位临时工的「工资簿」。

words.zhGloss: 公司间应计折旧资产的内部利润
words.enDefinition: assets associated with inter-company profit on depreciable
acceptedZhAnswers: 公司间应计折旧资产的内部利润

examples.en: Consolidation must eliminate inter-company profit on depreciable assets sold between group members.
examples.zh: 合并报表必须抵销集团成员之间出售应计折旧资产形成的「公司间应计折旧资产的内部利润」。

examples.en: The examiner asked how inter-company profit on depreciable assets unwinds as depreciation is charged.
examples.zh: 考官问的是：随着折旧的计提，「公司间应计折旧资产的内部利润」如何逐步转回。

collocations: classify inter-company profit on depreciable assets
measure inter-company profit on depreciable assets
disclose inter-company profit on depreciable assets

words.enDefinition: an audit focused on verifying balances in the statement of financial position

examples.en: A balance sheet audit concentrates on closing balances rather than the year's transactions.
examples.zh: 「资产负债表审计」重点关注期末余额，而不是全年的交易过程。

examples.en: Under a balance sheet audit, we confirmed every loan balance directly with the lender.
examples.zh: 在「资产负债表审计」中，我们逐笔直接向贷款方确认了余额。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for shipping

examples.en: The shipping invoice listed eleven cartons, but the dock only received nine.
examples.zh: 「货物装运单」上列了十一箱，码头实际只收到九箱。

examples.en: Payment terms say the shipping invoice must accompany the goods, never trail them.
examples.zh: 付款条款规定「货物装运单」必须随货同行，绝不能事后补寄。

words.enDefinition: receipts from revenue

examples.en: The treasury counts income tax and customs duties as its revenue receipts.
examples.zh: 财政部把所得税和关税计入本年度的「税收经常收入」。

examples.en: Privatisation proceeds are capital, not revenue receipts, so they cannot fund salaries.
examples.zh: 私有化所得属于资本性收入而非「税收经常收入」，不能用来发工资。

words.enDefinition: an audit of general

examples.en: The charity commissioned a general audit covering both donations and trading income.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构委托进行了一次「普通审计」，范围涵盖捐赠和经营收入。

examples.en: A general audit of the books revealed nothing worse than three untidy files.
examples.zh: 对账簿的「普通审计」只查出了三个乱糟糟的文件夹，没有别的问题。

words.enDefinition: an audit of repeating

examples.en: The bank ordered a repeating audit after the same teller error surfaced twice.
examples.zh: 同一出纳差错两度出现后，银行下令进行「重复审计」。

examples.en: A repeating audit wastes fee budgets unless each visit tests something new.
examples.zh: 除非每次都核查新内容，否则「重复审计」只会白白消耗审计费用。

words.enDefinition: an audit of repeat

examples.en: The regulator scheduled a repeat audit of the branch within six months.
examples.zh: 监管机构要求六个月内对该分行进行一次「重复审计」。

examples.en: We fixed the stockroom records in April, so the repeat audit passed within hours.
examples.zh: 四月份我们修正了库房记录，所以「重复审计」几小时内就顺利通过。

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of sales contract

examples.en: The builder carries a sales contract receivable for the sixth house, signed but unsettled.
examples.zh: 建筑商账上挂着一笔第六套房的「应收销售合同款」，合同已签但款项未清。

examples.en: A sales contract receivable ages badly once the buyer's mortgage approval stalls.
examples.zh: 一旦买方的按揭审批卡壳，「应收销售合同款」的账龄就会越拖越难看。

words.enDefinition: a salesmen's salaries and commission used in professional practice

examples.en: Salesmen's salaries and commission together took nearly a fifth of turnover last year.
examples.zh: 去年「销售员薪金及佣金」合计吃掉了近五分之一的营业额。

examples.en: We split salesmen's salaries and commission so commission rises only with collected cash.
examples.zh: 我们把「销售员薪金及佣金」分列处理，佣金只随实收现金增长。

words.enDefinition: a slip documenting a sale

examples.en: Keep the sales slip; the warranty office refuses claims without it.
examples.zh: 保留好「销售单」，保修部门没有它就不受理索赔。

examples.en: Every sales slip is carbon-copied, one for the till, one for the customer.
examples.zh: 每张「销售单」都复写一式两联，一联留收银机，一联给顾客。

words.enDefinition: accounting for distribution cost

examples.en: Distribution cost accounting separated warehouse rent from delivery fuel for the first time.
examples.zh: 「销售领域成本会计」首次把仓库租金与送货油费分开核算。

examples.en: With distribution cost accounting, the northern route proved dearer than anyone had guessed.
examples.zh: 通过「销售领域成本会计」，北方线路的费用比所有人的估计都要高。

collocations: roll forward the distribution cost accounting

words.enDefinition: an audit of administrative

examples.en: The council's administrative audit questioned why office supplies were ordered from three suppliers.
examples.zh: 市政会的「行政审计」质询了办公用品为何从三家供应商分散采购。

examples.en: An administrative audit checks procedure and paperwork, not the accuracy of the accounts themselves.
examples.zh: 「行政审计」核查的是流程与文书，而非账目数字本身的准确性。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from unearned

examples.en: Unearned revenue shrinks every month as coaching sessions are actually delivered.
examples.zh: 随着辅导课程逐月实际交付，「预收收入」不断减少。

examples.en: The airline's unearned revenue peaks in January, when everyone books summer holidays.
examples.zh: 一月人人预订暑期度假，「预收收入」在航空公司账上达到峰值。

words.enDefinition: profits arising from after-tax

examples.en: After-tax profits rose eleven percent, though the dividend stayed flat.
examples.zh: 「税后利润」上升了百分之十一，分红却保持不变。

examples.en: The co-op returns after-tax profits to members as a rebate on purchases.
examples.zh: 合作社把「税后利润」按购物金额返还给社员。

words.enDefinition: accounting for agency

examples.en: Under agency accounting, the dealer only records commission, never the goods themselves.
examples.zh: 在「代理店会计」下，经销商只记录佣金，从不记录商品本身。

examples.en: Agency accounting keeps consignment stock off our books until it actually sells.
examples.zh: 寄售存货直到实际售出前都不进我们的账，这正是「代理店会计」的用法。

words.enDefinition: accounts used to track agency

examples.en: Agency accounts record money the agent merely collects on the principal's behalf.
examples.zh: 「代理人账」只记录代理人代委托人收取的款项。

examples.en: The estate agent keeps agency accounts separate from her own business takings.
examples.zh: 房产经纪人把「代理人账」与自己收到的业务款项严格分开。

words.zhGloss: 存于海关保税仓库中的进口货物
words.enDefinition: goods held in a bonded warehouse pending customs clearance and duty payment
acceptedZhAnswers: 存于海关保税仓库中的进口货物

examples.en: The whisky sits under bond until the excise duty is finally paid.
examples.zh: 这批威士忌「存于海关保税仓库」，直到消费税最终缴清。

examples.en: Buyers can taste whisky still under bond, but taking it home costs duty.
examples.zh: 买家可以品鉴「存于海关保税仓库」的威士忌，但要带回家就得缴税。

words.enDefinition: accounting for equity

examples.en: Equity accounting shows our share of the venture's profit without consolidating it fully.
examples.zh: 「权益会计」只反映我们在合资企业利润中的份额，而不作全面合并。

examples.en: Under equity accounting, the associate's losses cut our carrying amount each quarter.
examples.zh: 在「权益会计」下，联营企业的亏损每季度都会冲减我们的账面金额。

words.enDefinition: a foundational concept used in accounting

examples.en: The matching principle is an accounting concept every first-year student learns early.
examples.zh: 配比原则是每个大一学生早早就要学的「会计观念」。

examples.en: Prudence as an accounting concept stops the board from booking hoped-for profits.
examples.zh: 谨慎性这一「会计观念」让董事会无法把憧憬中的利润提前入账。

words.enDefinition: an office handling accounting for branch

examples.en: Accounting for branch office activities feeds daily figures to the head office ledger.
examples.zh: 「支店会计」每天把分支机构的数据传送到总店总账。

examples.en: Accounting for branch office cash used to mean a courier with two receipts books.
examples.zh: 从前「支店会计」核算现金，得靠一名信使带着两本收据簿往返。

collocations: record the accounting for branch office
disclose the accounting for branch office
reconcile the accounting for branch office

words.enDefinition: a calendar point relevant to accounting

examples.en: Our accounting date moved from March to December to match the parent.
examples.zh: 为与母公司一致，我们的「会计结算日」从三月改到了十二月。

examples.en: Cut-off testing checks every invoice against the accounting date, one day either side.
examples.zh: 截止测试会逐张核对发票与「会计结算日」前后各一天的情况。

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for accounting

examples.en: Accounting depreciation spreads the cost evenly, while tax depreciation front-loads the relief.
examples.zh: 「会计折旧」把成本均匀分摊，而税务折旧把优惠集中在前期。

examples.en: The gap between accounting depreciation and capital allowances creates our deferred tax.
examples.zh: 「会计折旧」与资本减免之间的差额，正是我们递延所得税的来源。

words.enDefinition: a division responsible for accounting

examples.en: The accounting division sits on the third floor, next to the archives.
examples.zh: 「会计部门」在三楼办公，紧挨着档案室。

examples.en: Every payment request crosses the accounting division twice: once for coding, once for release.
examples.zh: 每份付款申请都要两过「会计部门」：一次确定科目，一次批准放款。

words.zhGloss: 内部报告会计(管理会计)
words.enDefinition: accounting intended for internal reporting
acceptedZhAnswers: 内部报告会计(管理会计)

examples.en: Accounting for internal reporting can use whatever units management finds genuinely useful.
examples.zh: 「内部报告会计」可以采用管理层认为真正有用的任何计量单位。

examples.en: Unlike the statutory accounts, accounting for internal reporting arrives every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 与法定报表不同，「内部报告会计」每周一早上准时送达。

collocations: sample the accounting for internal reporting
vouch the accounting for internal reporting
tie out the accounting for internal reporting

words.enDefinition: a professional firm that provides accountancy and related services

examples.en: The accountancy firm moved us to cloud bookkeeping and cut our filing panic.
examples.zh: 那家「会计机构」把我们迁移到云端记账，申报时的手忙脚乱从此消失。

examples.en: Our accountancy firm employs two trainees who chase every missing receipt each autumn.
examples.zh: 我们委托的「会计机构」雇了两名实习生，每年秋天专门追讨缺失的票据。

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record abstract

examples.en: Job costs from each work order were posted daily into the abstract ledger.
examples.zh: 每张工单的成本每天都过入「作业费用总账」。

examples.en: At month end the abstract ledger total had to agree with the wages journal.
examples.zh: 月末时，「作业费用总账」的合计数必须与工资日记账一致。

words.enDefinition: accounting for divisional

examples.en: Divisional accounting revealed that the Leeds depot had subsidised everyone else for years.
examples.zh: 「分部门会计」显示，利兹仓库多年来一直在补贴其他部门。

examples.en: With divisional accounting, each region bids for its own vans and staff.
examples.zh: 实行「分部门会计」后，各区都要为自己的车辆和人员争预算。

words.enDefinition: a manual describing accounting policies and procedures

examples.en: The accounting manual spells out who may sign for which amount.
examples.zh: 「会计规程」明确规定什么金额该由谁签字。

examples.en: New starters receive the accounting manual plus a short quiz before touching the ledger.
examples.zh: 新员工要读完「会计规程」并通过小测验，才能碰分类账。

words.enDefinition: money received from accounting

examples.en: Accounting income follows the matching rules, so cash timing barely matters.
examples.zh: 「会计所得」遵循配比规则，现金收付的时间几乎无关紧要。

examples.en: Taxable profit diverges from accounting income whenever the two rulebooks disagree.
examples.zh: 两套规则一旦打架，应税利润就会偏离「会计所得」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in accounting transactions

examples.en: For project appraisal, economists value the timber at its accounting price, not the subsidised one.
examples.zh: 在项目评估中，经济学家按「会计价格」对木材计价，而不是用补贴价。

examples.en: The accounting price strips out taxes and subsidies to show the real resource cost.
examples.zh: 「会计价格」剔除税负和补贴，反映出真实的资源成本。

words.enDefinition: an audit of voucher

examples.en: The voucher audit matched every payment slip to an authorised purchase order.
examples.zh: 「凭证审计」把每张付款单与经批准的采购订单一一对应。

examples.en: During the voucher audit we found thirty payments lacking any approval signature.
examples.zh: 「凭证审计」中发现三十笔付款没有任何审批签字。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from taxable

examples.en: Adjusting accounting profit for entertaining and depreciation gives the taxable profit.
examples.zh: 对会计利润调整招待费和折旧等项目，就得出「应纳税的利润」。

examples.en: Losses carried forward reduce taxable profit until the trading record turns positive again.
examples.zh: 结转亏损会继续抵减「应纳税的利润」，直到经营重新盈利为止。

words.enDefinition: a clerk who records and tracks factory costs

examples.en: The factory cost clerk weighs scrap every Friday and files the variance sheet.
examples.zh: 「工厂成本管理员」每周五称量废料，并归档差异表。

examples.en: Our factory cost clerk knows every machine's output better than the supervisors do.
examples.zh: 我们的「工厂成本管理员」对每台机器的产出比主管们还清楚。

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of subscription

examples.en: Subscription receivable of twelve thousand remains from the spring share issue.
examples.zh: 春季增发仍有一万二千英镑的「应收认股款」未收。

examples.en: The directors chased every subscription receivable before calling the board meeting.
examples.zh: 召开董事会之前，董事们把每笔「应收认股款」都催了一遍。

words.enDefinition: assets associated with depreciation for plant

examples.en: Depreciation for plant assets starts when the machine is ready for use, not at purchase.
examples.zh: 「固定资产折旧」从机器可投入使用时起算，而不是从购买日起。

examples.en: The schedule of depreciation for plant assets lists each press, its life, and method.
examples.zh: 「固定资产折旧」明细表逐台列示压机的使用寿命和折旧方法。

words.enDefinition: output of depreciation-service

examples.en: Under the depreciation-service output approach, the tractor's cost follows the acres it ploughs.
examples.zh: 按「生产服务折旧法」，拖拉机的成本跟着它耕作的土地面积走。

examples.en: Depreciation-service output suits quarry machinery whose wear tracks tonnes crushed, not calendar months.
examples.zh: 「生产服务折旧法」适合采石场设备——机器磨损取决于破碎吨数，而非日历月份。

words.enDefinition: a trade barrier used in professional practice

examples.en: The new licensing rule works as a trade barrier against foreign dairy imports.
examples.zh: 新的许可制度实质上是针对外国乳制品进口的一道「贸易壁垒」。

examples.en: Quotas, standards, and customs delays are all trade barriers dressed in different clothes.
examples.zh: 配额、技术标准和海关拖延，都是换了个马甲的「贸易壁垒」。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of trade accounts

examples.en: Trade accounts payable cover suppliers of goods, not the electricity or the rent.
examples.zh: 「贸易应付账款」只覆盖货品供应商，不包括电费和租金。

examples.en: Trade accounts payable turned over every forty days, which the bank considers healthy.
examples.zh: 「贸易应付账款」约四十天周转一次，银行认为这属于健康水平。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of excessive held for sale or use

examples.en: Excessive stock of tinsel after January ties up cash for eleven months.
examples.zh: 一月过后「存货超额」的金属箔条，会把现金占压十一个月。

examples.en: The stockroom floods with excessive stock whenever buyers guess the fashion wrong.
examples.zh: 采购一旦看走眼流行趋势，库房立刻被「存货超额」淹没。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for export
