examples.en: Each export invoice names the vessel, the port, and the consignee in triplicate.
examples.zh: 每份出口「货物装运单」都一式三份，注明船名、港口和收货人。

examples.en: Customs will not release the cargo until the export invoice is stamped.
examples.zh: 出口「货物装运单」盖章之前，海关不会放行货物。

words.enDefinition: invoices supporting expense claims

examples.en: Collect expense invoices weekly, or the tax office disallows the whole claim.
examples.zh: 每周都要收齐「费用清单」，否则税务局会驳回整笔申报。

examples.en: Her expense invoices filled a shoebox: train tickets, coffees, and one questionable lamp.
examples.zh: 她的「费用清单」装满了一个鞋盒：火车票、咖啡，还有一盏来路可疑的台灯。

words.zhGloss: 公司间应收及应付款项
words.enDefinition: inter-company receivables and payables used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 公司间应收及应付款项

examples.en: Inter-company receivables and payables must net to zero in the consolidated accounts.
examples.zh: 在合并报表中，「公司间应收及应付款项」必须相互抵销为零。

examples.en: The two subsidiaries disputed inter-company receivables and payables for three months straight.
examples.zh: 两家子公司为「公司间应收及应付款项」整整争执了三个月。

words.enDefinition: an audit of monthly balance sheet

examples.en: A monthly balance sheet audit keeps the bank's covenant figures beyond dispute.
examples.zh: 每月一次「月份资产负债表审计」，让银行的契约指标无可争辩。

examples.en: The client hates the monthly balance sheet audit, yet admits it catches errors early.
examples.zh: 客户嘴上嫌弃「月份资产负债表审计」，却也承认它能及早发现差错。

collocations: prioritise the monthly balance sheet audit
standardise the monthly balance sheet audit
monitor the monthly balance sheet audit

words.enDefinition: a manual of cost accounting methods and rates

examples.en: The cost manual fixes a standard hourly rate for every workshop process.
examples.zh: 「成本手册」为每道车间工序规定了标准工时费率。

examples.en: Everyone quotes from the cost manual, so two estimators never disagree by much.
examples.zh: 所有人都按「成本手册」报价，两个估价员的口径不会相差太多。

words.enDefinition: a tax levied on a corporation’s taxable profits

examples.en: Corporation profit tax is charged on adjusted profits, not on the published figure.
examples.zh: 「公司利润税」按调整后的利润征收，而不是按对外公布的数字。

examples.en: Smaller firms pay corporation profit tax at a reduced rate below the threshold.
examples.zh: 门槛以下的小公司按较低税率缴纳「公司利润税」。

words.zhGloss: 净价法(采购或销售折扣记帐)
words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling net price
acceptedZhAnswers: 净价法(采购或销售折扣记帐)

examples.en: Under the net price method, we record purchases assuming every discount is taken.
examples.zh: 按「净价法」，我们记账时假定所有购货折扣都会被享用。

examples.en: Missing a discount under the net price method shows up as an extra expense.
examples.zh: 在「净价法」下错失折扣，就会直接体现为一笔额外费用。

words.enDefinition: a manual of accounting used in professional practice

examples.en: The manual of accounting defines every code the branch offices must use.
examples.zh: 「会计手册」规定了各分支办事处必须使用的每一个科目编码。

examples.en: Whenever the standard changes, the manual of accounting gets a new page by email.
examples.zh: 准则一有变动，「会计手册」就会通过邮件增发新页。

words.enDefinition: accounting for manufacturing

examples.en: Manufacturing accounting tracks material, labour, and overhead from raw stock to finished units.
examples.zh: 「制造业会计」追踪从原材料到成品的材料、人工和间接费用。

examples.en: Her first job in manufacturing accounting was pricing a single bolt for the tender.
examples.zh: 她在「制造业会计」岗位上的第一项任务，是为投标核算一颗螺栓的成本。

words.enDefinition: accounting for manufacturing cost

examples.en: Manufacturing cost accounting charged the recall to the batch that failed inspection.
examples.zh: 「制造成本会计」把召回费用记到了未通过检验的那一批次头上。

examples.en: Through manufacturing cost accounting we learned the paint shop costs more than assembly.
examples.zh: 通过「制造成本会计」我们才发现，喷漆车间的成本竟然高于装配。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage manufacturing overhead

examples.en: The manufacturing overhead control account gathers every indirect factory cost for the month.
examples.zh: 「制造费用控制账户」归集了当月工厂的每一笔间接费用。

examples.en: When manufacturing overhead control shows an under-absorption, rates get recalculated for next quarter.
examples.zh: 一旦「制造费用控制账户」出现分配不足，下一季度就要重新测算分配率。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage inventory

examples.en: Good inventory control means the freezer never holds more than a fortnight of stock.
examples.zh: 良好的「存货控制」意味着冷柜里的货从不超过两周的用量。

examples.en: Barcodes on every carton made inventory control almost effortless for the volunteers.
examples.zh: 每个纸箱贴上条形码后，志愿者做「存货控制」几乎不费力气。

words.enDefinition: methods used to account for inventory

examples.en: The exam asked us to compare inventory accounting methods on identical purchases.
examples.zh: 考题要求我们就相同的进货比较各种「存货的会计处理方法」。

examples.en: Switching inventory accounting methods needs disclosure, because profits shift with the choice.
examples.zh: 变更「存货的会计处理方法」必须披露，因为利润会随选择而变动。

words.enDefinition: accounting for inventory

examples.en: Inventory accounting treats transport inward as part of the cost of every box.
examples.zh: 「存货会计」把进货运费计入每箱货物的成本。

examples.en: Her chapter on inventory accounting ends with the cut-off rules for deliveries.
examples.zh: 她那章「存货会计」以到货截止规则作结。

words.enDefinition: audits of marketing activities and effectiveness

examples.en: Annual marketing audits ask whether each campaign actually moved the numbers.
examples.zh: 年度「市场审计」要追问每场营销活动是否真正拉动了业绩。

examples.en: The consultants' marketing audits found the brochure budget outweighed every digital channel combined.
examples.zh: 顾问的「市场审计」发现，宣传册预算超过了所有数字渠道的总和。

words.enDefinition: the cost of invoice

examples.en: We value the returned goods at invoice cost, not at today's shelf price.
examples.zh: 退货按「发票价」计价，而不是按今天的货架价。

examples.en: Freight excluded, the invoice cost of each mixer came to forty-two pounds.
examples.zh: 不含运费，每台搅拌机的「发票价」为四十二英镑。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates inventory-sales

examples.en: A falling inventory-sales ratio means shelves turn faster than they did last spring.
examples.zh: 「存货销售比率」下降，意味着货架周转比去年春天更快了。

examples.en: The buyer watches the inventory-sales ratio weekly before committing to any reorder.
examples.zh: 采购员每周盯着「存货销售比率」，再决定是否补货。

words.enDefinition: liquidating for inventory

examples.en: Inventory liquidating began in March, when everything without a barcode went discounted.
examples.zh: 三月启动了「压缩库存」，没有条形码的货一律打折处理。

examples.en: Careful inventory liquidating freed the cash that funded the second cold van.
examples.zh: 有条不紊的「压缩库存」腾出了资金，买下第二辆冷藏车。

words.enDefinition: accounting for customs cost

examples.en: Customs cost accounting lands duty, brokerage, and demurrage on the right product lines.
examples.zh: 「关税成本会计」把关税、代理费和滞港费落到正确的产品线上。

examples.en: After customs cost accounting, the imported sofa line quietly lost its margin.
examples.zh: 「关税成本会计」核算之后，进口沙发产品线的利润悄悄归零了。

collocations: roll forward the customs cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record customer's

examples.en: Every credit customer has a page in the customer's ledger with monthly totals.
examples.zh: 每位赊账客户在「应收账款分户账」中都有一页，按月合计。

examples.en: The debt collector works straight from the customer's ledger, oldest balances first.
examples.zh: 收账员直接照着「应收账款分户账」办事，先从最老的余额催起。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for outward

examples.en: Each outward invoice records the crates leaving for Rotterdam on Thursday's barge.
examples.zh: 每份「出口装货清单」都记录了周四驳船运往鹿特丹的板条箱。

examples.en: The outward invoice must match the packing list box for box at customs.
examples.zh: 在海关，「出口装货清单」必须与装箱单逐箱核对一致。

words.enDefinition: a tariff applied to import

examples.en: The new import tariff added eight percent to every consignment of steel.
examples.zh: 新的「进口关税」让每批钢材的成本多了百分之八。

examples.en: Farmers welcomed the import tariff on cheap grain, though bakers quietly objected.
examples.zh: 农户欢迎对廉价谷物征收「进口关税」，面包师们却私下反对。

words.zhGloss: 组成公司(社团)的会计师
words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in incorporated
acceptedZhAnswers: 组成公司(社团)的会计师

examples.en: The incorporated accountant signed the audit report on behalf of the small practice.
examples.zh: 这位「注册公司会计师」代表小型事务所签署了审计报告。

examples.en: Her father qualified as an incorporated accountant back when ledgers were handwritten.
examples.zh: 她父亲考下「注册公司会计师」资格时，账簿还全靠手写。

words.enDefinition: organisation costs that have been written off

examples.en: Organization costs written off appear in the notes as a single annual charge.
examples.zh: 「开办费摊销」在附注中列作一笔年度费用。

examples.en: Lawyers, registration fees, and the launch dinner all became organization costs written off.
examples.zh: 律师费、注册费和开业晚宴，全都成了「开办费摊销」的项目。

collocations: accrue the organization costs written off
restate the organization costs written off
roll forward the organization costs written off

words.enDefinition: a bank’s conditional undertaking to pay a beneficiary when stipulated documents are presented (letter of credit)

examples.en: Under the payment on receipt credit, the bank pays once the warehouse receipt appears.
examples.zh: 按「凭收据付款信用状」，银行一见到仓单就付款。

examples.en: The seller trusted the payment on receipt credit more than any open account.
examples.zh: 卖方更信任「凭收据付款信用状」，而不是任何挂账安排。

collocations: sample the payment on receipt credit
vouch the payment on receipt credit
tie out the payment on receipt credit

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage payroll

examples.en: Payroll control failed when one manager both hired staff and approved their pay.
examples.zh: 一位经理既雇人又批薪，「工资控制」随之失效。

examples.en: Hours are clocked electronically, giving payroll control something solid to check against.
examples.zh: 工时改为电子打卡，「工资控制」便有了可对照的实据。

words.enDefinition: ratios derived from balance sheet amounts

examples.en: Lenders compare balance sheet ratios across five years before renewing the facility.
examples.zh: 续授信之前，银行会对比五年的「资产负债比率」。

examples.en: The gearing and liquidity metrics are both balance sheet ratios drawn from the same date.
examples.zh: 杠杆与流动性指标都是取自同一时点的「资产负债比率」。

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to forwarding agent's

examples.en: The forwarding agent's receipt proves the crates left our dock on the eleventh.
examples.zh: 「运输代理人收据」证明板条箱于十一日离开了我们的码头。

examples.en: Attach the forwarding agent's receipt to the claim, or the insurer delays payment.
examples.zh: 索赔时要附上「运输代理人收据」，否则保险公司会拖延赔付。

words.enDefinition: a time span used for pay

examples.en: Our pay period runs fortnightly, so overtime splits across two wage runs.
examples.zh: 我们的「工资支付期」按两周一轮，加班费会分摊到两次发薪里。

examples.en: Casual workers are paid at the end of each pay period, never early.
examples.zh: 临时工只能在每个「工资支付期」结束时领薪，从不提前。

words.zhGloss: 销售(货)部门薪金和费用
words.enDefinition: a sales management salaries and expense used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 销售(货)部门薪金和费用

examples.en: Sales management salaries and expense are budgeted separately from the reps' commission pool.
examples.zh: 「销售部门薪金和费用」与销售代表的佣金池分开编列预算。

examples.en: The chief scrutinised sales management salaries and expense after two quarters of losses.
examples.zh: 连续两个季度亏损后，一把手仔细审查了「销售部门薪金和费用」。

collocations: record the sales management salaries and expense
disclose the sales management salaries and expense
reconcile the sales management salaries and expense

words.zhGloss: 制造(间接)费用预算差异帐户
words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track factory expense budget variation
acceptedZhAnswers: 制造(间接)费用预算差异帐户

examples.en: The factory expense budget variation account holds the gap between allowed and actual overhead.
examples.zh: 「制造费用预算差异账户」记录预算间接费用与实际发生额之间的差额。

examples.en: Bookkeepers closed the factory expense budget variation account straight into cost of sales.
examples.zh: 簿记员把「制造费用预算差异账户」直接结转进销售成本。

collocations: prioritise the factory expense budget variation account
standardise the factory expense budget variation account
monitor the factory expense budget variation account

words.zhGloss: 存货成本计算方法的分析
words.enDefinition: an analysis comparing methods of costing inventory
acceptedZhAnswers: 存货成本计算方法的分析

examples.en: Our analysis of inventory costing methods showed FIFO overstating profit during inflation.
examples.zh: 我们对「存货成本计算方法的分析」显示，通胀期先进先出法会高估利润。

examples.en: The report's analysis of inventory costing methods filled eleven pages with worked examples.
examples.zh: 报告中的「存货成本计算方法的分析」部分用实例演算写了十一页。

collocations: classify analysis of inventory costing methods
measure analysis of inventory costing methods
disclose analysis of inventory costing methods

words.enDefinition: a statement showing assets, liabilities, and equity at a point in time

examples.en: The balance sheet balances because every asset was funded by someone.
examples.zh: 「资产负债表」之所以平衡，是因为每项资产背后都有出资人。

examples.en: One glance at the balance sheet told the buyer the stock was overvalued.
examples.zh: 看一眼「资产负债表」，买方就明白存货被高估了。

words.enDefinition: a structure of balance sheet debt

examples.en: The group's balance sheet debt structure shifted from bank loans toward supplier credit.
examples.zh: 集团的「资产负债表债务结构」从银行贷款转向了供应商赊账。

examples.en: Analysts praised the balance sheet debt structure: maturities spread evenly over ten years.
examples.zh: 分析师称赞其「资产负债表债务结构」：到期日在十年内均匀分布。

collocations: test the balance sheet debt structure
refine the balance sheet debt structure
compare the balance sheet debt structure

words.enDefinition: a tariff applied to sliding

examples.en: A sliding tariff rises with the world price, cushioning local refiners.
examples.zh: 「浮动关税」随国际价格上行而提高，为本国炼厂提供缓冲。

examples.en: Under the sliding tariff, importers pay less duty when freight costs spike.
examples.zh: 在「浮动关税」下，运费飙升时进口商缴纳的关税反而减少。

words.enDefinition: credits related to delayed

examples.en: The auction house books delayed credits only once the buyer actually settles.
examples.zh: 拍卖行只等买方实际结清后才确认「过期账收入」。

examples.en: Half the delayed credits from November remained uncollected at the February review.
examples.zh: 到二月复核时，十一月的「过期账收入」还有一半没有收回。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of average held for sale or use

examples.en: We compute average stock by adding opening and closing balances, then halving.
examples.zh: 把期初与期末余额相加再除以二，就算出「平均存货」。

examples.en: Turnover based on average stock reads fairer than one built on a single date.
examples.zh: 用「平均存货」算周转率，比只用某一天的数字更公允。

words.enDefinition: an audit of site

examples.en: The site audit ran three days inside the client's Warrington depot.
examples.zh: 这次「就地审计」在客户的沃灵顿仓库现场进行了三天。

examples.en: A site audit lets us watch the loaders actually scan each pallet.
examples.zh: 「就地审计」让我们亲眼看到装卸工逐板扫码。

words.enDefinition: accounts used to track balance sheet

examples.en: Balance sheet accounts carry forward, while income accounts close off every year.
examples.zh: 「资产负债表账户」逐期结转，而收益类账户每年结清。

examples.en: The software locks balance sheet accounts once the year-end journal is approved.
examples.zh: 年终分录一经批准，系统就会锁定「资产负债表账户」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for standard cost

examples.en: Standard cost accounting flags every hour the line runs beyond the norm.
examples.zh: 「标准成本会计」会把产线超时运行的每一个小时都标出来。

examples.en: Under standard cost accounting, mixtures of cheap and dear flour show as mix variances.
examples.zh: 在「标准成本会计」下，贵贱面粉的掺配差异会体现为结构差异。

collocations: tie out the standard cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for stock

examples.en: The stock budget caps how much yarn the mill may buy each month.
examples.zh: 「存货预算」规定了纱厂每月最多可采购多少纱线。

examples.en: Season peaks blow the stock budget, so the board pre-approves a Christmas allowance.
examples.zh: 旺季会冲破「存货预算」，所以董事会预先批准了圣诞额度。

words.enDefinition: auditing of financial statement

examples.en: Financial statement auditing gives outsiders a reason to trust the printed numbers.
examples.zh: 「财务报表审计」给了外部人相信纸面数字的理由。

examples.en: My year of financial statement auditing taught me more than three lecture courses.
examples.zh: 一年的「财务报表审计」实务教给我的，比三门课加起来还多。

collocations: tie out the financial statement auditing

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record stock

examples.en: Transfers of shares are entered in the stock ledger the day they complete.
examples.zh: 股份转让完成的当天，就要登记进「股东分户账」。

examples.en: The registrar certifies holdings straight from the stock ledger at each dividend date.
examples.zh: 每次派息日，登记员都直接凭「股东分户账」核证持股。

words.enDefinition: a keeper of stock

examples.en: The stock keeper signs for every delivery before it crosses the warehouse door.
examples.zh: 每批到货都必须先由「存货管理人」签收，才能进仓库大门。

examples.en: Our stock keeper radios the floor the moment shelf two runs below ten.
examples.zh: 二号货架一旦少于十件，「存货管理人」立刻用电台通知楼层。

words.enDefinition: accounting for stewardship

examples.en: Stewardship accounting shows trustees exactly how they handled the money entrusted to them.
examples.zh: 「管理人会计」向受托人准确展示他们如何处置了受托资金。

examples.en: Estate stewardship accounting kept the heirs informed through every year of probate.
examples.zh: 遗产认证的每个年头，「管理人会计」都让继承人知情。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for stocking

examples.en: A stocking agent holds goods locally so dealers never wait for the continent.
examples.zh: 「存货代理人」在当地备货，经销商无须苦等来自欧洲大陆的货。

examples.en: Our stocking agent arranges delivery within a day across the whole midlands.
examples.zh: 我们的「存货代理人」能让中英格兰全境一天之内到货。

words.enDefinition: a stop payment of salary used in professional practice

examples.en: The board voted to stop payment of salary until the missing stock was explained.
examples.zh: 在库存缺失问题交代清楚之前，董事会表决「停止支付薪金」。

examples.en: They cannot simply stop payment of salary without following the disciplinary procedure.
examples.zh: 不走完纪律处分程序，公司不能随意「停止支付薪金」。

words.enDefinition: profits arising from stock

examples.en: Stock profits vanish when buyers stop paying yesterday's prices for today's timber.
examples.zh: 一旦买家不再按昨天的价格购买今天的木材，「存货利润」便会蒸发。

examples.en: The builder's stock profits came simply from holding land and timber during inflation.
examples.zh: 建筑商的「存货利润」不过是通胀期间持有土地和木材赚来的。

words.enDefinition: accounts used to track stockholders' equity

examples.en: Share buybacks reduce the stockholders' equity accounts rather than the profit line.
examples.zh: 回购股份冲减的是「股东权益账户」，而不是利润行。

examples.en: Revaluation gains sit inside stockholders' equity accounts until the assets are sold.
examples.zh: 重估增值一直留在「股东权益账户」中，直到资产出售为止。

words.enDefinition: a godown for deposit

examples.en: The tea waits in the deposit godown until the excise stamps arrive.
examples.zh: 茶叶暂存「存货仓库」，等印花税票到了再提货。

examples.en: The deposit godown by the docks rents space by the pallet per week.
examples.zh: 码头边的「存货仓库」按托盘每周计收仓储费。

words.enDefinition: a statement of account sent to customers

examples.en: The statement to customers goes out on the first, listing every open invoice.
examples.zh: 「购货客户清单」每月一号寄出，逐笔列示未结发票。

examples.en: Customers who dispute the statement to customers get a copy of their ledger page.
examples.zh: 对「购货客户清单」有异议的客户，会收到其分户账页的副本。

words.enDefinition: a range of asset depreciation

examples.en: Our asset depreciation range gives delivery vans eight to twelve years of life.
examples.zh: 我们的「资产折旧幅度」规定送货货车可用年限为八至十二年。

examples.en: Within the asset depreciation range, we pick the shorter end for harsh-use vehicles.
examples.zh: 在「资产折旧幅度」之内，使用环境恶劣的车辆我们取较短的年限。

collocations: roll forward the asset depreciation range

words.enDefinition: accounts used to track assets and liabilities

examples.en: Assets and liabilities accounts stay open across years, unlike the sales accounts.
examples.zh: 与销售类账户不同，「资产负债账户」跨年连续存在。

examples.en: The trial balance lists all assets and liabilities accounts before the income items.
examples.zh: 试算平衡表先列全部「资产负债账户」，再列收益类项目。

words.enDefinition: accounting for automation of cost

examples.en: Automation of cost accounting freed the clerks to analyse rather than copy.
examples.zh: 「成本会计的自动化」让职员从抄录中解放出来，转做分析。

examples.en: Automation of cost accounting means machine hours flow straight from the sensors into the ledgers.
examples.zh: 有了「成本会计的自动化」，机器工时直接从传感器流入账簿。

collocations: accrue the automation of cost accounting
restate the automation of cost accounting
roll forward the automation of cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a department of accounting used in professional practice

examples.en: The department of accounting admitted eighty freshmen this September, the largest cohort yet.
examples.zh: 今年九月「会计系」录取了八十名新生，是历届最多的一届。

examples.en: Her office sits on the fourth floor of the department of accounting building.
examples.zh: 她的办公室在「会计系」大楼的四层。

words.zhGloss: 存货的平均成本计算法
words.enDefinition: an average costing of inventory used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 存货的平均成本计算法

examples.en: Average costing of inventory smooths the price swings between weekly flour deliveries.
examples.zh: 「存货的平均成本计算法」熨平了每周面粉到货之间的价格波动。

examples.en: Under average costing of inventory, each batch leaves the store at the same blended rate.
examples.zh: 在「存货的平均成本计算法」下，每批出库货物都按相同的混合单价计价。

words.enDefinition: accounting for average cost

examples.en: Average cost accounting spread the big steel order across the whole year's output.
examples.zh: 「平均成本会计」把那笔大额钢材订单的成本摊到了全年产量上。

examples.en: The shift to average cost accounting ended the monthly seesaw in reported margins.
examples.zh: 改用「平均成本会计」后，报表毛利率的月度大起大落消失了。

collocations: roll forward the average cost accounting

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to average deposit

examples.en: The average deposit receipt covered the jettisoned cargo after the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴过后，那批弃货由「海损保证金收据」提供担保。

examples.en: Claimants present the average deposit receipt before the maritime adjuster releases any funds.
examples.zh: 理算师放款之前，索赔方须出示「海损保证金收据」。

words.enDefinition: customs invoices required for special clearance

examples.en: The consulate stamps the special customs invoices needed for clearance into that market.
examples.zh: 领事馆为进入该国市场所需的「特别海关发票」加盖印章。

examples.en: Without the special customs invoices, the shipment idled two weeks at the border.
examples.zh: 缺了「特别海关发票」，那批货在边境滞留了两周。

words.enDefinition: an audit of special

examples.en: The board ordered a special audit into the missing petty cash.
examples.zh: 董事会就失踪的零用现金下令进行一次「特别审计」。

examples.en: A special audit traced the duplicate payments to one supplier account within days.
examples.zh: 「特别审计」几天内就把重复付款追到了同一个供应商账户。

words.enDefinition: a document presenting information about auditor's

examples.en: The auditor's report runs to nine pages, mostly about the warehouse valuation.
examples.zh: 「审计报告书」长达九页，主要内容是仓库估值。

examples.en: Every auditor's report carries the signature, the date, and the firm's registration number.
examples.zh: 每份「审计报告书」都载有签名、日期和事务所注册号。

words.enDefinition: fundamental rules applied to auditing

examples.en: Independence and evidence are the auditing principles every trainee recites first.
examples.zh: 独立性与证据是每个新人在「审计学原理」中首先背诵的原则。

examples.en: The course on auditing principles uses the vintage fraud cases as its spine.
examples.zh: 「审计学原理」课程以那些经典舞弊案例为主线。

words.enDefinition: a general principle applied in auditing

examples.en: The handbook condenses the auditing generality into a page every checker can quote.
examples.zh: 手册把「审计通则」压缩成一页，每位查账员都能脱口而出。

examples.en: Where statutes are silent, the auditing generality fills the gap for public bodies.
examples.zh: 法令未作规定之处，「审计通则」为公共机构补上依据。

words.enDefinition: a certificate documenting auditor's

examples.en: The bank wants the auditor's certificate before it releases the second tranche.
examples.zh: 银行要先拿到「审计证明书」，才会拨付第二笔款项。

examples.en: Each auditor's certificate confirms the figures agree with the underlying vouchers.
examples.zh: 每份「审计证明书」都确认报表数字与原始凭证相符。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for audit

examples.en: Audit expense rose this year because the group added two overseas subsidiaries.
examples.zh: 集团今年新增两家海外子公司，「查账费用」随之上升。

examples.en: We compare audit expense quotes from three firms every second year.
examples.zh: 每隔一年，我们就向三家事务所询价比较「查账费用」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for specific order cost

examples.en: Specific order cost accounting attaches every bolt and hour to a named job.
examples.zh: 「分批成本会计」把每颗螺栓、每个工时都挂到具名的订单上。

examples.en: Under specific order cost accounting, job 214 finally showed why it lost money.
examples.zh: 在「分批成本会计」下，214号订单终于露出了亏损的原因。

words.enDefinition: planning an audit and designing the audit programme/procedures

examples.en: Audit planning and programming happen in November, before anyone books the fieldwork.
examples.zh: 「审计计划和审计程序」的制定安排在十一月，先于现场工作的预订。

examples.en: Good audit planning and programming cut our second-year fieldwork almost in half.
examples.zh: 周到的「审计计划和审计程序」让第二年的现场工作几乎减半。

words.enDefinition: the objective an audit is designed to achieve

examples.en: The audit objective here is simple: prove the receivables exist and are collectible.
examples.zh: 这里的「审计目标」很简单：证明应收账款真实存在且可收回。

examples.en: Each programme line traces back to one audit objective and one assertion.
examples.zh: 方案中的每一行都能追溯到某一项「审计目标」和某一项认定。

words.enDefinition: a process used for audit

examples.en: The audit process starts with engagement acceptance, not with the first voucher.
examples.zh: 「审计程序」从承接业务开始，而不是从第一张凭证开始。

examples.en: Clients see only the tail of the audit process: the queries and the sign-off.
examples.zh: 客户看到的只是「审计程序」的尾声：问询函和签字确认。

words.zhGloss: 会计的各个专门化方面
words.enDefinition: a specialized phases of accounting used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 会计的各个专门化方面

examples.en: Tax, audit, and cost work are the specialized phases of accounting this degree covers.
examples.zh: 税务、审计和成本工作都是该学位所授「会计的各个专门化方面」。

examples.en: After qualifying she rotated through the specialized phases of accounting before choosing tax.
examples.zh: 取得资格后，她轮岗体验了「会计的各个专门化方面」，最后选定了税务。

words.enDefinition: a tax levied in respect of revenue

examples.en: The levy on imported tobacco is a revenue tax, aimed purely at the exchequer.
examples.zh: 对进口烟草征收的税属于「收入关税」，目的纯粹是充实国库。

examples.en: A revenue tax keeps rates modest so smuggling never becomes worthwhile.
examples.zh: 「收入关税」税率保持温和，走私便永远无利可图。

words.enDefinition: accounting for retail

examples.en: Retail accounting values the shop's stock using the retail method, not unit counts.
examples.zh: 「零售会计」采用零售价法为店铺存货计价，而不是逐件清点。

examples.en: Her textbook on retail accounting devotes a chapter to mark-downs and mark-ups.
examples.zh: 她那本「零售会计」教材专门用一章讲降价与加价。

words.enDefinition: an audit of responsibility

examples.en: The responsibility audit asked which manager signed off the cancelled orders.
examples.zh: 「责任审计」追查了究竟哪位经理批准取消了那些订单。

examples.en: A responsibility audit links each cost centre's overspend to a named budget holder.
examples.zh: 「责任审计」把每个成本中心的超支对应到具名的预算负责人。

words.enDefinition: tariffs imposed in retaliation for another country’s measures

examples.en: The government answered the steel duties with retaliatory tariffs on their cheese.
examples.zh: 针对对方的钢材关税，政府以奶酪「报复性关税」回敬。

examples.en: Retaliatory tariffs usually hurt both sides before the negotiators finally sit down.
examples.zh: 「报复性关税」往往两败俱伤，之后谈判代表才会最终坐下来。

words.enDefinition: routine financial accounting that records transactions and prepares general-purpose statements

examples.en: General accounting closes the monthly books by the fifth working day.
examples.zh: 「普通会计」在第五个工作日前完成月度结账。

examples.en: Her first job in general accounting covered everything from post to payroll postings.
examples.zh: 她在「普通会计」岗位的第一份差事，从收发室一直管到工资过账。

words.enDefinition: accounting for retail store

examples.en: Retail store accounting treats every till discrepancy above five pounds as an investigation.
examples.zh: 在「零售业会计」中，收银差异超过五英镑一律立案调查。

examples.en: The chain's retail store accounting merges each shop's cash summary every night.
examples.zh: 连锁店的「零售业会计」每晚汇总各家门店的现金日报。

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to general average deposit

examples.en: The general average deposit receipt secures every cargo owner's share of the sacrifice.
examples.zh: 「共同海损保证金收据」为每位货主分摊的牺牲份额提供担保。

examples.en: Without the general average deposit receipt, customs refuses to release the container.
examples.zh: 没有「共同海损保证金收据」，海关不予放行集装箱。

words.enDefinition: a glut the market used in professional practice

examples.en: Over-planting last spring threatened to glut the market with cooking apples.
examples.zh: 去春种植过量，烹饪用苹果眼看要出现「市场存货过剩」。

examples.en: Cheap imports glutted the market, and our margin fell for three straight quarters.
examples.zh: 廉价进口货令「市场存货过剩」，我们的利润率连续三个季度下滑。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of goods in held for sale or use

examples.en: The website marks goods in stock in green, everything else in grey.
examples.zh: 网站把「库存货物」标成绿色，其余一律显示灰色。

examples.en: We insure the goods in stock at cost, not at the hopeful mark-up.
examples.zh: 「库存货物」按成本投保，而不是按一厢情愿的加价。

words.enDefinition: a tag marking stock that has been reserved

examples.en: A red reserved stock tag means that pallet is already promised to an order.
examples.zh: 红色「保留存货标签」表示该托盘已承诺给某张订单。

examples.en: Pickers must not touch anything carrying a reserved stock tag, however urgent the queue.
examples.zh: 无论队列多急，拣货员都不能碰挂有「保留存货标签」的货品。

words.enDefinition: accounting for replacement cost

examples.en: Replacement cost accounting revalues the fleet at what a new van would cost today.
examples.zh: 「重置成本会计」按今天购置新货车的价格对车队重新计价。

examples.en: Under replacement cost accounting, holding gains show separately from trading profits.
examples.zh: 在「重置成本会计」下，持有收益与经营利润分开列示。

collocations: roll forward the replacement cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track rent payable

examples.en: The rent payable account shows two months accrued since the landlord moved abroad.
examples.zh: 房东移居国外后，「应付租金账户」已累计两个月的应计租金。

examples.en: Post the quarterly demand straight into the rent payable account, then schedule payment.
examples.zh: 把季度缴款通知直接记入「应付租金账户」，再安排付款。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of rent

examples.en: Rent payable for the kiosk is three hundred monthly, paid in advance.
examples.zh: 售货亭的「应付租金」为每月三百英镑，需预付。

examples.en: We negotiate rent payable down each renewal, trading a longer lease for the cut.
examples.zh: 每次续约我们都把「应付租金」谈低一些，用更长的租期交换减租。

words.enDefinition: a replacement method of depreciation used in professional practice

examples.en: The replacement method of depreciation charges what the asset would cost new today.
examples.zh: 「重置成本折旧法」按该资产今日全新重置价计提折旧。

examples.en: Under the replacement method of depreciation, inflation quietly raises the annual charge.
examples.zh: 在「重置成本折旧法」下，通胀会悄悄推高年度折旧额。

words.enDefinition: customers with debit balances owed to the entity

examples.en: Debit customers owe us money, while credit customers are the ones we owe.
examples.zh: 「借方客户」欠我们钱，而贷方客户是我们欠的人。

examples.en: The aged listing of debit customers feeds the collection calls every Monday.
examples.zh: 每周一的催收电话，就是照着「借方客户」账龄清单打的。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from reported

examples.en: Reported profit doubled, but the cash statement told a quieter story.
examples.zh: 「报告利润」翻倍，现金流量表讲的却平静得多。

examples.en: Analysts strip one-off gains before comparing reported profit across the three retailers.
examples.zh: 分析师会先剔除一次性收益，再比较三家零售商的「报告利润」。

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record shareholders

examples.en: The shareholders ledger records each holding with its certificate numbers and dates.
examples.zh: 「股东明细分户账」逐笔记录各持仓及其股票凭证号和日期。

examples.en: Before the dividend, the company secretary prints the shareholders ledger for the register check.
examples.zh: 派息之前，公司秘书打印「股东明细分户账」以核对名册。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for franco

examples.en: The franco invoice means delivery, insurance, and duty all sit in one price.
examples.zh: 「全部费用在内价发票」意味着运费、保险和关税都含在一个价格里。

examples.en: Under a franco invoice, the seller carries every cost up to our warehouse door.
examples.zh: 按「全部费用在内价发票」，卖方承担直到我们仓库门口的一切费用。

words.enDefinition: property financed or held as funded assets

examples.en: The trust deed lists the funded property backing the pension promises.
examples.zh: 信托契约列明了支撑养老金承诺的「长期资产」。

examples.en: Funded property cannot be sold without the trustees meeting first and voting.
examples.zh: 未经受托人会议先行表决，「长期资产」不得出售。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of salaries

examples.en: Salaries payable stood at two months of payroll when the auditor arrived.
examples.zh: 审计师到场时，「应付薪金」已相当于两个月工资额。

examples.en: We clear salaries payable on the twenty-fifth, the same day every month.
examples.zh: 我们每月二十五日结清「应付薪金」，从不间断。

words.enDefinition: a ticket or slip recording a sale

examples.en: The waiter drops a sales ticket at the till the moment you order.
examples.zh: 你一点单，服务员就把「销售单」打进收银机。

examples.en: Each sales ticket numbers sequentially, so a missing sheet is obvious by lunch.
examples.zh: 每张「销售单」连续编号，到午饭前缺没缺一查便知。

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record sales

examples.en: The sales ledger keeps one folio per customer with every invoice filed behind it.
examples.zh: 「销售客户分户账」为每位客户单设一页，发票按序归在其后。

examples.en: Credit control works from the sales ledger, ringing anyone past thirty days.
examples.zh: 信用管理照着「销售客户分户账」办事，超过三十天的客户都会接到电话。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for sales

examples.en: We raise a sales invoice the day the pallet leaves the yard.
examples.zh: 托盘一出货场，我们当天就开具「销售发票」。

examples.en: The customer queries the sales invoice because two delivery charges appear on it.
examples.zh: 客户对「销售发票」提出质疑，因为上面出现了两笔运费。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track deferred pension liability

examples.en: The deferred pension liability account carries the staff pensions earned but not yet funded.
examples.zh: 「延期养老金负债账户」记录员工已挣得但尚未拨足的养老金。

examples.en: Actuarial gains flow straight into the deferred pension liability account each year end.
examples.zh: 每逢年末，精算利得都会直接冲减「延期养老金负债账户」。

collocations: sample the deferred pension liability account
vouch the deferred pension liability account
tie out the deferred pension liability account

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for full cost less

examples.en: The insurer valued the workshop at full cost less depreciation, per the policy wording.
examples.zh: 按保单条款，保险公司以「减折旧后全部成本」评估车间价值。

examples.en: Full cost less depreciation for the mill now sits barely above scrap value.
examples.zh: 这座磨坊的「减折旧后全部成本」如今只比废料价值略高。

collocations: sample the full cost less depreciation
vouch the full cost less depreciation
tie out the full cost less depreciation

words.enDefinition: assets associated with disposal of depreciable

examples.en: Disposal of depreciable assets must pass through the tenders committee, no exceptions.
examples.zh: 「应计折旧资产的出售」必须经过招标委员会，毫无例外。

examples.en: The gain or loss on disposal of depreciable assets lands in the same note.
examples.zh: 「应计折旧资产的出售」损益统一列在同一附注中。

words.enDefinition: accounting for advanced

examples.en: Advanced accounting covers consolidations, foreign currency, and partnership conversions in one brutal module.
examples.zh: 「高级会计」用一个硬核模块讲完合并报表、外币和合伙转换。

examples.en: She tutors first-years in advanced accounting to fund her professional exams.
examples.zh: 她靠给新生辅导「高级会计」来筹措职业考试的费用。

words.enDefinition: accounting for advanced management

examples.en: Advanced management accounting introduced balanced scorecards and transfer pricing to the cohort.
examples.zh: 「高级管理会计」课程向学员介绍了平衡计分卡和转让定价。

examples.en: The plant adopted advanced management accounting ideas only after the consultant drew the maps.
examples.zh: 直到顾问画出流程图之后，工厂才采纳「高级管理会计」的理念。

words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for unit

examples.en: Unit costing tells the bakery exactly what each loaf absorbs from the ovens.
examples.zh: 「单位成本会计」精确算出每个面包从烤炉中分摊的成本。

examples.en: With unit costing, quoting a wedding cake of any size takes minutes.
examples.zh: 有了「单位成本会计」，任何尺寸的婚礼蛋糕几分钟就能报价。

words.enDefinition: accounting for uniform cost

examples.en: Trade bodies publish uniform cost accounting schemes so member firms stay comparable.
examples.zh: 行业组织发布「统一成本会计」方案，使会员企业口径可比。

examples.en: Under uniform cost accounting, the cooperative's twelve farms report identical cost headings.
examples.zh: 在「统一成本会计」下，合作社的十二家农场使用完全相同的成本科目。

collocations: tie out the uniform cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a system for uniform cost accounting

examples.en: The ministry imposed a uniform cost accounting system on every licensed nursing home.
examples.zh: 部委对所有持牌养老院强制推行「统一成本会计制度」。

examples.en: A uniform cost accounting system let the franchisor benchmark every outlet fairly.
examples.zh: 有了「统一成本会计制度」，特许方就能公平地给各家门店排名。

collocations: sample the uniform cost accounting system
vouch the uniform cost accounting system
tie out the uniform cost accounting system

words.zhGloss: 单项折旧合计分组折旧法
words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling unit summation depreciation
acceptedZhAnswers: 单项折旧合计分组折旧法

examples.en: Under the unit summation depreciation method, each machine keeps its own schedule before totalling.
examples.zh: 按「单项折旧合计分组折旧法」，每台机器先单独计提再汇总分组。

examples.en: The unit summation depreciation method suits workshops mixing old and new equipment.
examples.zh: 「单项折旧合计分组折旧法」适合新旧设备混用的车间。

collocations: apply the unit summation depreciation method
adopt the unit summation depreciation method
document the unit summation depreciation method

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling units of production

examples.en: Under the units of production method, the press charges depreciation per thousand cartons.
examples.zh: 按「生产单位法」计提折旧，压机按每千个纸箱折算。

examples.en: The units of production method fits quarry plant whose life depends on tonnes moved.
examples.zh: 「生产单位法」适合采石设备——寿命取决于搬运吨数。

collocations: test the units of production method
refine the units of production method
compare the units of production method

words.enDefinition: accounting for electronic data processing

examples.en: Electronic data processing accounting replaced the punch-card clerks by the mid-seventies.
examples.zh: 到七十年代中期，「电子数据处理会计」取代了穿孔卡片记账员。

examples.en: The bank's early electronic data processing accounting needed a room-sized computer and three operators.
examples.zh: 银行早期的「电子数据处理会计」需要一台占满整间屋的电脑和三名操作员。

words.enDefinition: the value attributed to manufacturers' inventories

examples.en: The census reports the value of manufacturers' inventories every quarter without fail.
examples.zh: 统计调查每季度必报「制造业存货价值」。

examples.en: Rising steel prices lifted the value of manufacturers' inventories across the whole region.
examples.zh: 钢价上涨推高了整个地区「制造业存货价值」的数字。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of distributor's held for sale or use

examples.en: The distributor's stock of spring bulbs must be sold before planting season ends.
examples.zh: 经销商的春季球茎「经销商存货」必须在种植季结束前卖完。

examples.en: Consigned but unsold, the distributor's stock stays on our balance sheet until invoiced.
examples.zh: 寄售未售的「经销商存货」在开票前仍留在我们的资产负债表上。

words.enDefinition: the foundation used to measure distribution

examples.en: Under the distribution basis, warehouse costs follow the cubic metres each line occupies.
examples.zh: 按「分摊成本制」，仓储费用按各产品线占用的立方米分摊。

examples.en: The finance manual fixes the distribution basis so departments cannot cherry-pick allocations.
examples.zh: 财务手册固定了「分摊成本制」，各部门无权挑肥拣瘦。

words.enDefinition: accounting for elementary cost

examples.en: Elementary cost accounting starts with job cards and materials requisitions, nothing fancier.
examples.zh: 「初级成本会计」从工单和领料单学起，不搞花哨的东西。

examples.en: The apprentice absorbed elementary cost accounting from the foreman's worn notebook.
examples.zh: 学徒从工头那本翻旧的笔记里学到了「初级成本会计」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for administrative

examples.en: Administrative accounting keeps the office rent, insurance, and stationery neatly separated.
examples.zh: 「事务会计」把办公室房租、保险和文具费用分得清清楚楚。

examples.en: Her administrative accounting role quietly kept the whole practice compliant and supplied.
examples.zh: 她的「事务会计」工作默默保障着整个事务所的合规与物资供应。

words.zhGloss: 未审核(计)的资产负债表
words.enDefinition: a statement of financial position that has not yet been examined by an independent auditor
acceptedZhAnswers: 未审核(计)的资产负债表

examples.en: The unaudited balance sheet accompanied the loan application as a draft.
examples.zh: 贷款申请随附了一份作为草稿的「未经审计的资产负债表」。

examples.en: Every unaudited balance sheet in the pack is stamped draft in red.
examples.zh: 文件包里每份「未经审计的资产负债表」都盖着红色的草稿章。

words.zhGloss: 代理会计责任总(明细)表
words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record agent's accountability
acceptedZhAnswers: 代理会计责任总(明细)表

examples.en: The agent's accountability ledger tracks every consignment the shipping agent still holds.
examples.zh: 「代理会计责任账」逐笔追踪货运代理尚未交付的每一批寄售货物。

examples.en: We reconcile the agent's accountability ledger against the agent's monthly remittance.
examples.zh: 我们把「代理会计责任账」与代理人的月度汇款逐笔核对。

words.enDefinition: a turnover of payable used in professional practice

examples.en: The turnover of payable slowed to four times a year under the new terms.
examples.zh: 在新条款下，「应付款项周转率」放慢到一年四次。

examples.en: Rising turnover of payable signals the builders' merchants are chasing us for cash.
examples.zh: 「应付款项周转率」上升，说明建材商正在向我们催款。

collocations: roll forward the turnover of payable

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of turnover of accounts

examples.en: The turnover of accounts receivable reached nine after the credit terms tightened.
examples.zh: 信用条款收紧后，「应收账款周转率」达到了九次。

examples.en: A falling turnover of accounts receivable usually means someone stopped paying entirely.
examples.zh: 「应收账款周转率」下降，往往意味着有客户彻底停止付款了。

collocations: sample the turnover of accounts receivable
vouch the turnover of accounts receivable
tie out the turnover of accounts receivable

words.enDefinition: receivables related to turnover

examples.en: Sales grew, and turnover receivables figures now crowd every board pack.
examples.zh: 销售增长后，董事会文件里满是「应收款项周转率（额）」的数字。

examples.en: Compare turnover receivables against the industry norm before extending more open credit.
examples.zh: 放宽赊账之前，先把「应收款项周转率（额）」与行业常态比较一下。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates turnover of receivable

examples.en: The turnover of receivable ratio dipped below three, which alarmed the auditors.
examples.zh: 「应收款项周转比率」跌破三次，令审计员警觉起来。

examples.en: We recalculate the turnover of receivable ratio whenever a large customer changes terms.
examples.zh: 每当大客户变更账期，我们都会重算「应收款项周转比率」。

collocations: calculate the turnover of receivable ratio
compare the turnover of receivable ratio
interpret the turnover of receivable ratio

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of turnover of held for sale or use

examples.en: The turnover of stock improved once we cleared the discontinued paint lines.
examples.zh: 清掉停产的油漆产品线后，「存货周转率」随之改善。

examples.en: Grocers live on a fast turnover of stock, restocking fresh lines daily.
examples.zh: 食品杂货商靠快速的「存货周转率」生存，新鲜货品每天补货。

words.enDefinition: a turnover rate concerning receivables

examples.en: The turnover rate of receivables slipped to five after the takeover distracted the credit team.
examples.zh: 并购事务分神信用团队后，「应收账款周转率」滑落到五次。

examples.en: Banks read the turnover rate of receivables before agreeing to any seasonal overdraft.
examples.zh: 银行批准季节性透支之前，会先看「应收账款周转率」。

words.enDefinition: a turnover ratio of inventory used in professional practice

examples.en: The turnover ratio of inventory hit twelve after the just-in-time conversion.
examples.zh: 实施准时制改造后，「存货周转率」达到十二次。

examples.en: A falling turnover ratio of inventory often hides obsolete lines nobody will write down.
examples.zh: 「存货周转率」下降，往往掩盖着没人肯减记的淘汰产品线。

collocations: calculate the turnover ratio of inventory
compare the turnover ratio of inventory
interpret the turnover ratio of inventory

words.enDefinition: money received from after-tax

examples.en: After-tax income finally covers the mortgage once the second job starts paying.
examples.zh: 等第二份工作开薪，「纳税后收入」终于够还房贷了。

examples.en: The trust distributes its after-tax income to the beneficiaries every December.
examples.zh: 信托每年十二月把「纳税后收入」分配给受益人。

words.zhGloss: 税后收益(付税后收益)率
words.enDefinition: yield earned from after-tax
acceptedZhAnswers: 税后收益(付税后收益)率

examples.en: The municipal bond's after-tax yield beat the corporate alternative for higher-rate taxpayers.
examples.zh: 对高税率纳税人来说，市政债的「税后收益率」胜过了公司债。

examples.en: Compare after-tax yield, not headline coupons, when the two accounts differ in tax.
examples.zh: 两个账户税负不同时，要比「税后收益率」，而不是表面票息。

words.enDefinition: accounting for enterprise

examples.en: Enterprise accounting for the group consolidated eleven entities across four countries.
examples.zh: 集团的「企业会计」合并了分布在四个国家的十一个主体。

examples.en: The course on enterprise accounting assumes you already balance a trial balance blindfolded.
examples.zh: 「企业会计」这门课默认你已经能闭着眼把试算平衡表做平。

words.enDefinition: accounting for entity

examples.en: Entity accounting treats each unit as separate, even when the same family owns all.
examples.zh: 「单位会计」把每个主体都视为独立记账，即使同属一个家族。

examples.en: Entity accounting keeps the charity's books apart from the trading arm's.
examples.zh: 依靠「单位会计」，慈善组织的账目与经营实体的账目泾渭分明。

words.enDefinition: an equity method of accounting used in professional practice

examples.en: The equity method of accounting books our share of the associate's profit annually.
examples.zh: 按「权益会计法」，联营企业利润中我们的份额每年入账一次。

examples.en: Under the equity method of accounting, dividends received reduce the carrying amount instead.
examples.zh: 在「权益会计法」下，收到的股利改为冲减账面金额。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for duplicate

examples.en: The duplicate invoice in our file proves the original was never paid.
examples.zh: 我们档案里的「发票副本」证明原件从未获得支付。

examples.en: Please attach the duplicate invoice when you resend the payment request.
examples.zh: 重发付款申请时，请随附「发票副本」。
